Snow falling in the temple forest.

Hey, that's a bit harsh, don't you think?

Right….

Now then, Prince, we're going to sweep out the monsters
that have taken up residence in the snowy country.
m920136.エーテルさん、いま解呪しますから、\n早くこちらへ――: Ertel, I'll dispel it now, so come quickly—
m920136.エーテルを操るなんて許せませんわ。\n王子、急いで追いかけますわよ！:
I cannot forgive someone who manipulates Ertel.
Prince, let's chase after them quickly!
m920136.ゴブリン博士の技術を用い、\n我こそが魔王様を継ぐ者だと見せつけてやろう！:
Using Goblin Doctor's technology,
I will show them that I am the one to inherit the Demon King's legacy!
m920136.ゴブリン博士よ、王国軍が来たぞ。\n迎撃のために\nデラックス版メカドラゴンを放: Goblin Doctor, the kingdom's forces are here. Release the deluxe Mecha Dragon for interception!
m920136.デューオ、私もついていくわ。\n王子はエーテルを慰めてあげること。いいわね？:
Duo, I'm coming with you.
You, Prince, are to comfort Ertel. Understood?
m920136.デューオさん、ソラノさん、\nいったい雪の国に何が起きているのですか？: Duo, Solano, what on earth is happening in the Snow Country?
m920136.デラックス版に続き、コンプリート版メカドラゴンは、\n飛行オプションを搭載したい:
Following the Deluxe model, the Complete Mecha Dragon
is equipped with flight options, making it the ultimate form!
Prince, let me end your life right here...!!
m920136.デーモン、エーテルを解放しろ！\n魔王ガリウスはもういないんだぞ！:
Demon, release Ertel!
The Demon King Garius is gone!
m920136.デーモンが向かった先は……。\nやはり、おもちゃ工場が本拠地になっているようね。: The place the Demon headed… indeed, it seems the toy factory has become their base.
m920136.ナッ……！？\nデラックス版は確かにミニ版よりも強力ダガ、\nまだ調整が終わって: Wha…!? The deluxe version is indeed more powerful than the mini, but it's still not fully tuned…
m920136.ナニ……！？\n試作品だけでなく、設計段階のコンプリート版マデ！？: What…!? Not just a prototype, but a fully-designed Complete version!?
m920136.フンッ、それがどうした！\n今ならば王子達を倒せば、\n魔王様よりも強い存在だと:
Hmph, so what?
If we defeat the Prince and his party now,
we can easily prove we are stronger than the Demon King.
m920136.ベルトコンベアの上じゃ上手く動けないはずだ。\n王子、搬出されている間に攻撃して: The conveyor's not a place we can move well. Prince, while they're being shipped out, let's strike and take them down quickly!
m920136.ミニメカドラゴンがひとりでに動いて……！？\nトトノさんっ、あぶない……っ！！: The tiny mechanical dragon is moving on its own…!? Totono-san, watch out…!
m920136.メカゴブリンクイーンを失ったゴブリン族など、\nもはや数が多いだけの雑兵だろう。: The goblin tribe that lost their Mecha Goblin Queen are nothing but a swarm of foot soldiers now.
m920136.メカゴブリンクイーン様であれば、\n潤沢な予算と余裕のある納期をくれたのに……。: If only the Mecha Goblin Queen had given us ample budget and a relaxed deadline… Damn you, damned demons…!!
m920136.一向に戻ってきませんね……。\n雪の国というからには、\n積雪がすごくて雪の国か: They haven't come back at all… Since it's the Snow Country, maybe the snowfall is so heavy they can't leave?
m920136.何事も無ければ、帰りに観光案内をしてあげるわ。\nサンタクロースの一族のひとりと: If nothing goes wrong, I'll give you a tour on the way back. As a member of Santa's clan, of course♪
m920136.分かってますよ。\nこのミニメカドラゴン、\n子供用とは思えない機能が搭載されて: I know. This mini-mecha dragon had capabilities you wouldn't expect from a kids' toy.
m920136.問答無用だ！\nベルトコンベアを動かせ！！: No questions! Get the conveyor belt moving!
m920136.大雪で足止め、という可能性は考えにくいわね。\nもしかしたら、雪の国で何かが起き: It's hard to imagine they'd be stuck by snow. Maybe something's happening in the Snow Country?
m920136.子供達にくばる前で本当に良かったです……。\nともかく、一度製造元に問い合わせて: I'm really glad we stopped it before handing it out to the kids… Anyway, let's contact the manufacturer.
m920136.子供達のためのおもちゃを作る工場で、\nこんな兵器を作っているなんて……。: To think they're making weapons in a factory meant to craft toys for children…
m920136.実地試験でもナク、いきなり実戦で\nそんな未完成品を動かすことナド、\n私の美学: Running an untested prototype straight into battle goes against my very philosophy…!!
m920136.我らはかつての敵ではありますが、\nあえて利のない戦いをしようとは思いません。:
Though we were once your enemies,
we have no desire to wage a futile war.
m920136.本当ですの！？\nふふふっ、楽しみですわ♪: Is that so!? Hehe, I'm looking forward to it♪
m920136.残党が強がってるってわけね……。\n王子、あんなヤツさっさと倒して、\nエーテル:
So the remnants are just talking big...
Prince, let's take that guy down quickly
and save Ertel!
m920136.物質界全土で、復興作業中ではありますが、\n子供達にそんなことは関係ありませんか: Reconstruction is underway across the material world, but that doesn't concern the kids. The most important thing is that they play happily and energetically.
m920136.王子、こちらも戦闘準備をお願いします。\n雪の国では見られなかったメカゴーレムも:
Prince, please prepare for battle on our end as well.
It seems there are mecha golems here that we haven't seen in the Snow Country.
Please exercise caution!
m920136.王子、ミニメカドラゴンの展開してる障壁は、\n弱い攻撃を弾いちゃうタイプのやつだ: Prince, the barrier the mini-mecha dragon is projecting is the kind that deflects weak attacks. And that massive mechanism—if we destroy it, it might self-destruct!
m920136.王子、何か変な音がしませんか？\nまるで機械が大量に動いているような……。:
Prince, do you hear that strange noise?
It sounds like a massive amount of machinery moving...
m920136.王子、奥からでっかいメカドラゴンが飛んでくるよ。\n地上だけじゃなく、上にも気を:
Prince, a huge Mecha Dragon is flying in from the back.
Watch out for the sky, not just the ground!
m920136.王子、精神支配が解けたみたいですわ！\nエーテル、大丈夫ですの？ エーテルっ！:
Prince, the mind control seems to have been broken!
Ertel, are you all right? Ertel!
m920136.王子、雪だるまとエーテルさんが来ます！\n迎撃の指揮をお願いします！: Prince, the snowmen and Ertel are coming! Please command the interception!
m920136.確かに、これがクリスマスのプレゼントとなれば、\n子供達も大喜び間違いなしだな！: Indeed, if this becomes a Christmas present, the kids would be overjoyed for sure!
m920136.確か物質界だと……クリスマスの時には、\n何か変な挨拶が……えーっと……？:
I think in the Material World… on Christmas,
people say some kind of strange greeting… um…?
m920136.私……お、王子に、なんてことを……っ！\nぐすっ……うぅぅ……。:
I... I did... something terrible to... the Prince...!
Sob... uuu...
m920136.私を助けに――い、いやいや、そんなハズはナイ！\nダガこれは好機……どうにか逃げ: They came to rescue me—no, no, that can't be! This is a chance… I'll figure out a way to escape—
m920136.話し込んでいる暇はないぞ。\nミニメカドラゴンの軍団が迫っている。: We don't have time to chat. The mini-mecha-dragon legion is closing in.
m920136.雪の国のためにも、子供達のためにも、\n工場を支配しているデーモンを倒さねばなり: For the Snow Country and for the children, we have to defeat the demon that's taken over the factory.
m920136.魔王様は討たれ、クロコ様も行方が知れず……。\nそして魔界への門を開くこともでき:
The Demon King has been defeated, and Croco is nowhere to be found...
And we cannot open the gate to the Demon Realm either...
m920136.魔王様を失った我らだが、\nその志を継ぐ者は少なくない。\nここで王子達を倒すの: Though we've lost the Demon King, many still carry on his will. We'll crush the Prince here…!!
m920136.魔王軍の残党が……雪の国の工場を乗っ取ったんだ。\nミニメカドラゴンのおもちゃは: The remnants of the Demon King's army… seized the Snow Country's factory. The mini-mecha-dragon toys are one of the weapons they made.

m920148.――うぅ、じゃあ私も！\nひとくちだけなら良いですよね！:
――Ugh, then I'll have some too!
Just one bite, right?
m920148.――さぁ王子、出発の準備だ。\n行くぞ、幻のグルメジャングルへ……！！:
――Now then, Prince, let's get ready to depart.
We're heading to the Legendary Gourmet Jungle…!!
m920148.――た、大変だ！\n新鮮な食材が目を覚ましちゃったらしい！:
―Oh no, it's terrible!
The fresh ingredients have woken up!
m920148.――というわけで王子、\n私がドラコレックス役になって突撃するから、\nしっかり:
――So, Prince,
I'll take on the role of the Drocorex and charge in.
Make sure you brace yourself properly!
m920148.――伝説のグルメジャングルは、\n強力な竜族である、ドラコレックスの棲息地なんで:
――The legendary Gourmet Jungle is the habitat of the Dracorex,
a powerful species of dragon.
m920148.――幻のグルメジャングル、ですか。\n冗談みたいな名前の森ですね……。:
――The Legendary Gourmet Jungle, is it?
That's quite a ridiculous name for a forest…
m920148.――王子、来てくれたのか！\n大変なんだ、夏祭り会場に魔物が現れて……！:
――Prince, you've arrived!
This is serious. Monsters have appeared at the Summer Festival grounds…!
m920148.――至高の食材があるという幻の秘境。\n我々王国軍はドラコレックスのお肉を求めて:
――A legendary hidden land said to hold the ultimate ingredients.
Our royal army ventured into the Gourmet Jungle
in search of the flesh of the Drocorex――.
m920148.……あっ、あぁぁ！！\n王子、レギーナさん、手がかりを見つけました……！:
……Ah, aah!!
Prince, Regina, I found a clue……!
m920148.……お、思い出しました！！\n確かグルメジャングルには、\nドラコラプトルを信仰:
Oh, I remember!!
I'm pretty sure there's a tribe in the Gourmet Jungle
that worships the Draco Raptor!
m920148.……ごくり。\nまさか、まだ他にも食材を確保するおつもりで……？:
……(Swallows)
You're planning to secure even more ingredients……?
m920148.……はっ、ついつい楽しくて\n花火を上げすぎてしまった。:
…Hah, I got carried away having so much fun.
I ended up launching way too many fireworks.
m920148.……ふふふ、王子ならそう言ってくれると信じていた。\nそれじゃあさっそく行こう！:
……Heh heh heh, I did believe you would say that, Prince.
Then let's get started right away!
To the Legendary Gourmet Jungle…!!
m920148.……よろこべ。\nヌシらを歓迎すると、\nドラコラプトル様が言っていル。:
……Rejoice.
The Great One has spoken,
and welcomes the masters.
m920148.……ドラコラプトル様が、負けタ！\nおお、何ということだ！\n伝説の英雄王の再来:
……The Great One has lost!
Oh, what is this!
The legendary Hero King has returned!
m920148.……仕方ない。\nこれも屋台ごはんのため――ではなく、\n祭りを楽しみにする民の:
……Very well.
It's not for the street food itself—
it's for the people looking forward to the festival.
m920148.……食材を集めるのは良いですが、\nちゃんとお祭りの日までに帰還しましょうね？:
……Gathering ingredients is all well and good,
but let's make sure to get back before the festival, okay?
m920148.あ、あの、レギーナさん？\nさすがにドラコレックス役を人間がこなすのは、\nちょ:
U-um, Regina?
I think it might be a bit much for a human to play the Drocorex…
m920148.ああ、任せておけ！\n夏祭りの屋台を、ひときわ豪華にしてやるぞ！:
Ah, leave it to me!
I'll make the festival stalls the most lavish of all!
m920148.ああ、文明社会から隔絶していたがゆえに、\n独自の食材――もとい生物が棲息してい:
Ah, yes. Because it has been isolated from civilized society,
a jungle renowned for harboring its own unique ingredients—
I mean, creatures—has become the stuff of legend.
m920148.あはは……あくまで通称なんですけどね。\n猟師や料理人の間では有名な話ですよ。:
Ahaha… well, it is just a nickname, after all.
It's a well-known story among hunters and chefs.
m920148.あー……あれは、模擬戦、なのかな？: Ah… I think that's a sparring match?
m920148.いや、面目ない。\n鮮度が最優先だと思ってだな……。:
I'm sorry.
I thought keeping them fresh was the top priority……
m920148.うわぁ、ほんとに食材何も残ってないよー！\nうぅぅ、焼きとうもろこし食べたかった:
Whoa, there really isn't a single ingredient left!
Uuu, I wanted to eat some grilled corn.
m920148.え、えいゆう、おう……？\nもしかして、英雄王様も\nグルメジャングルに来たこと:
H-Hero King……?
Could it be that the Hero King
has also visited the Gourmet Jungle!?
m920148.えぇっ、それなら私も……っと、あら……？\nこの足跡は……見覚えがあるような……:
Ehh, if that's the case, I'll have some too……wait, oh……?
These footprints……they look familiar…….
m920148.えぇーっ！？ き、気をつけてくださいね？\nドラコラプトルは凶暴なドラゴンで、\:
W-What?! P-Please be careful!
The Draco Raptor is a vicious dragon, and
it attacks without hesitation once it spots prey!
m920148.えっ、えぇと……。\nドラコレックスとはまた一味違った、\nコクのある旨味がある:
W-Well…….
They say it has a rich, deep flavor
that's different from the Drocorex……?
m920148.お、王子！ 見てください！\n巨大なドラゴンが２頭もいます！:
Oh, Prince! Look!
There are two giant dragons!
m920148.おお、良かった！\nどうやらこちらの思いが通じたようだ！:
Oh, wonderful!
It seems our message got through after all!
m920148.お詫びとして、\n我らのチョコレート畑に案内しよウ。:
As an apology,
we will guide you to our chocolate fields.
m920148.くっ……その食材は夏祭りに備えて、\n皆が用意した大事なものなんだぞ……！:
Grr… those ingredients were precious supplies
everyone prepared for the Summer Festival…!
m920148.くっ……なんて咆哮だ……！\n聞いただけで体が痺れるようだ。:
Grrr…… what a roar……!
Just hearing it makes my skin crawl.
m920148.このままじゃ、屋台に\n何もない夏祭りになっちゃうわね……。:
At this rate, the stalls will be empty,
and the Summer Festival will be ruined…
m920148.こらこら、屋台で使う分が無くなってしまいますよ？\nレギーナさんからも言ってあげ:
Now, now, we'll run out of chocolate for the stalls!
Please tell Regina to stop――
m920148.これだけのお肉があれば、\nお祭りだけでなく、備蓄にも回せそうですね。\nふふふ:
With this much meat, we can supply not just the festival,
but the royal reserves as well.
Heh heh, I'm itching to get to cooking.
m920148.ご、豪華な食材って……もしや、\nあのジャングルに行くつもりですか……？:
L-lavish ingredients… You wouldn't mean to go to
that jungle, would you…?
m920148.しかしそろそろ決着がつきそうだな。\n片方はもうボロボロじゃないか。:
But it looks like it's about to reach a conclusion.
One of them is already in pretty bad shape.
--- scene: Chase the Phantom Dragon Meat! (battle, battle) ---
m920148.せっかくの夏祭り、最高の\nドラゴン肉を食べてみたいと思わないか？\n王子もそう:
Since it's the Summer Festival, don't you want to taste the finest
dragon meat?
I'm sure you agree, Prince?
m920148.せーのっ、どっかーん！！ どかーん！\nどどーん！ ひゅ～、どっかーん♪:
Here we go, doooon!! Doon!
Doooon! Hoo, doooon♪
m920148.そうだな……。\nよし、もう一周食べ歩きにいくぞ！:
That's true……
Alright, let's go on another food crawl!
m920148.そのまさかだ。\nこうなったら意地でも\n美味しい屋台ごはんを食べるぞ！:
That's exactly the plan.
At this point, I'm determined to eat the finest street food!
m920148.その上たっぷり眠ったおかげなのか、\n全然弱った様子もないらしい。\nとにかく食:
And because they got a good night's rest,
they don't seem to be weakened at all.
Please, help us subdue the ingredients!
m920148.それは何としてでも防がないと。\n王子、手を貸してくれ。\n魔物どもを一掃するぞ:
We must prevent that at all costs.
Prince, lend us your strength.
We'll wipe out these monsters!!
m920148.そんな運搬方法を……！？\nはっ……さっきのレギーナさんの花火で、\n食材の眠り:
To transport them that way……!?
Ah…… you mean Regina's fireworks earlier woke them up?
m920148.ただ、魔力を込めすぎると、\nあんな風に動くようになル。\nさぁ、好きなだけ収穫:
However, if we infuse too much magic power,
it starts moving like that.
Now then, please harvest as much as you like.
m920148.だが、その闘争本能までは消えていない。\n奴がこちらを値踏みしている、\n今がハ:
But that fighting instinct hasn't faded.
It's sizing us up.
This is our chance to hunt it!
m920148.だが、まだまだ食材が足りない。\nそうじゃないか、オーガスタ？:
But we're still short on ingredients.
Aren't we, Augusta?
m920148.だが、グルメジャングルの食材は、\nめったに市場に流通することはない。なぜなら―: However, ingredients from the Gourmet Jungle rarely make it to the market. The reason is――
m920148.ということは、ヌシらは王国の者カ。\nそれは失礼なことをしタ。:
So, the masters are from the kingdom.
I am sorry for our rude behavior.
m920148.ともあれ、王子、此度の\nドラコレックス狩猟作戦、お疲れさまでした！:
In any case, Prince,
well done on the Dracorex hunt!
--- scene: The Cheering Cannon, The Roaring Dragon (battle, start) ---
m920148.どうやら、あのドラコレックスも\n私たちに気付いたようです。\nこちらへ向かって:
It seems that Dracorex has noticed us too.
It's heading our way……!
m920148.どーんどっこどーん♪\nふっふっふ、みんな祭りを楽しんでいるみたいだな。:
Doon-dock-doon♪
Heh heh heh, looks like everyone's having a great time.
m920148.な、なるほど……。\nつまりあれは、魔力で動いているだけで、\n普通のチョコレー:
I-I see…….
So, it's just moving because of the magic power,
and it's regular chocolate.
m920148.なるほど……。\nそれでレーヴ、ドラコラプトルは美味しいのか？:
I see…….
Then, Reve, is the Draco Raptor delicious?
m920148.なるほど……。\nということは、今回の狩猟遠征では、\nドラコレックスを回避しな:
I see…
So, for this hunting expedition, we'll be hunting while avoiding the Dracorex?
m920148.はい。大地を駆けるのに適したこの形状、\nそしてグルメジャングルでも最大級の大き:
Yes. This shape is well-suited for running across the earth,
and it's the largest size in the Gourmet Jungle.
There's no mistake, these are Dracorex footprints!
m920148.ふぅ……ドラコレックス、討ち取った……！！: Phew…… we've taken down the Dracorex……!!
m920148.ふぅ、街の皆に被害は無かったみたいだ。\nでも食材を眠らせて運搬なんて、\nそん:
Phew, it looks like no one in town was hurt.
But putting ingredients to sleep for transport is way too dangerous.
Don't ever do that again, okay?
m920148.ふっふっふ、それは内緒だよ。\nでも今回は干し肉じゃなくて、とれたてのお肉だ！\:
Heh heh, that's a secret.
But this time, it's not jerky—it's fresh meat!
I wonder what it tastes like.
m920148.ふふっ、むしろその逆だ。\n私たちの狙う、最上級の獲物こそ、\nそのドラコレック:
Heh, quite the opposite.
The ultimate prey we're after is
that very Dracorex.
m920148.ふふふ、でもグルメジャングルが近いと思うと、\n居ても立っても居られなくてな。\:
Heh heh, but thinking about how close the Gourmet Jungle is,
I can't sit still.
Look, the Prince is getting restless too, isn't he?
m920148.ふふふ、反省するのは後にしましょう。\nさぁ王子、レギーナさん、\n夏祭りはまだ:
Hehe, let's save the apologies for later.
Come on, Prince, Regina,
the summer festival isn't over yet, is it?
m920148.ふむ……今度詳しく問い詰めさせてもらおう。\nところでデューオ、\nレギーナたち:
Hmm… I'll have to press you on the details later.
By the way, Duo,
what are Regina and the others doing?
m920148.ぺろぺろ……。\nん～！ これは美味しい……！！:
Lick, lick…….
Mmm~! This is delicious……!!
m920148.まさかここで、\nドラコレックスと戦うことになるとは……。:
I never expected we'd end up fighting a Dracorex
right here……
m920148.まさかこんなに早く、原住民に囲まれるとはな……。\nこちらに戦う意思がないことを:
I never expected to be surrounded by Natives this quickly…….
I just hope we can somehow convey that we have no intention of fighting…….
m920148.まったく、びっくりしてしまいましたよ。\nさぁレギーナさん、一緒に屋台に――って:
Honestly, you gave me quite a fright.

Ramuel, you face him first.

m920205.……シカシ、ソノォ……いまサラなのダガ。\nナゼ、敵でアル我々を信じる気にナッタ:

Why did you decide to trust us, even though we're the enemy?

m920205.……ペルセナス。\nどけ、お前に構ってる暇はないんだ。:

Move aside. I don't have time for you.

m920205.……先に王子の寿命が尽きるぞ、ランシェ。: ……The Prince's lifespan will run out first, Lanche.

Ever since the day you schemed and became my subordinate,
I was curious to see what you would actually accomplish…
m920205.……弓が、当たらない。\n狙いが定められません。:
……My arrows aren't finding their mark.
I can't even get a lock on him.

It's broad daylight, and yet――no, hmm…?
It doesn't look quite like a star…
m920205.……時の女神の、封印が砕けた。: ……The seal on the goddess of time has been broken.
m920205.……殺さずに済む道があるかもしれないと、\n思ってくださったのですか？: ……Did you think there might be a way to spare us?

……Please, never let your guard down.

Dias as he stands now is a being that transcends even a demigod.

Why are you aiding in the destruction of the world?

What on earth is that shield…?
m920205.……聞いてない、いや、聞いた上で、か。\nまぁいい。その選択もきっと、間違いじゃ:

Well, fine. That choice is probably not a mistake either.
m920205.……良いだろう。\nそれほどまでに、人の可能性を信じるのであれば――:

If you believe so deeply in the potential of humankind——

Capable of burning the entire surface of the earth, or something like that.
m920205.……話すと、長くなってしまうかも。\nただ、そうすべきだと、思っただけ。:

m920205.……起動？\nこの宮殿には、何か仕掛けがあるということですか？:
……Activated?
Does this palace have some kind of mechanism?
m920205.……過去に戻ったのはいいが、\nいったいどうするつもりなんだ？:
……Going back to the past is fine,

but what exactly do you intend to do?

The seat of the Creator God… the power to create the world, is in Dias's hands…
m920205.……雷霆の神の、継嗣。\nつまり……ペルセナスは、亜神ディアスの娘だ。:
……The successor of the God of Thunder.
In other words…… Persenas is the daughter of the Lesser God Zeus.
m920205.「時」という権能を与えられ、\nその強大さゆえに、自らを封じた女神クロノシア。:
Chronosia, the goddess granted the authority of "Time,"

who sealed herself away due to the sheer magnitude of her power.
m920205.『――ピピーッ、ガガガッ。\n王――子！ 聞こえルか！？』:
『――Bip, brrr.
Prin――ce! Can you hear me?!』
m920205.『気をツケヨ！ 要塞宮殿ガ――飛翔してイル！！』: 『Watch out! The Fortress Palace is――taking flight!!』
m920205.ああ……なるほどな、\nケラウノスが言ってたのは、あれじゃねぇか？:
Ah… I see.
So that's what Keraunos was talking about, huh?
m920205.ああ、まだ起動してないからな。\nどうにか間に合った、ってことだ。:
Ah, it hasn't been activated yet.
We just barely made it in time.
m920205.ああ、ディアスを追うぞ。\nここで仕留めなければ、\nいずれ未来は、一度経験した:
Ah, we pursue Dias.
If we do not put an end to her here,
the future will once again become the same one we have already experienced.
m920205.ああ、嫌いさ……。\nだけど……だから、\nそれを奪った貴様を、ぼくは許さない。:
Yes, I do hate them…
But… because of that,
I will not forgive you for taking it away from them.
m920205.ああ、認めよう……。\n貴様こそ、余を殺す者だ！！:
Ah, I concede…….
You are the one who will slay me!!
m920205.あいつは……亜神ディアスは、\n己の力と、その女神の力を束ねて、\n創造神と同等:
He… Dias,
intends to combine his own power with that goddess's
to achieve strength on par with the Creator!
m920205.あなたなら、自分で答えを掴み取れる。\nそう考えたから、何も言わないのよ。:
You can grasp the answer for yourself.
That's why she remains silent.
m920205.あなたの運命は、ひどく複雑なのです。\n例えば、神獣ニーズヘッグとの深い縁や――:
Your destiny is terribly complex.
For instance, your deep connection to the divine beast Nidhogg, and――
m920205.あなたは……ケラウノス様、ですか……？: You are… Lord Keraunos, are you not…?
m920205.あなたを、止めに来ましたよ。\n愚かな亜神、迷える雷霆、ディアスよ。:
I have come to stop you.
You foolish demi-god, you lost thunderbolt, Dias.
m920205.あなたを叱るのは、今の私の役割ではありませんよ。\n己に課した使命をなしとげ、\:

Accomplish the mission you set for yourself,
and after that――let my future self scold you.
m920205.あの場で助けなければ、女神を名乗れないでしょう。\nたとえ善性を象徴しない、この:
I would not be fit to call myself a goddess if I had not acted.
Even for someone like me, who does not embody benevolence.
m920205.あの雷撃が、安寧の世界――改変後の世界に\n招かない、悪を剪定するものだって話は:
I told you, that lightning was meant to prune the evil
that the world of peace—the altered world—
was not meant to harbor, right?!
m920205.あははは！ すごいすごい！\nまがい物の神器でよく耐えるね！:
Ahahaha! Amazing, amazing!
You held up well against a counterfeit divine artifact!
m920205.あら、あなたほどの頭脳を持つ者でも、\n分からないことがあるのね。:
Oh my, even someone with your intellect
has things they don't understand, I see.
m920205.あらゆる戦場で、生きることを願い、\n守ることを誓った戦士たちの魂が、\n必ず、:
The souls of warriors who wished to live
and swore to protect in every battlefield
will surely become your strength.
m920205.あー、まぁ、うーん、そう、なる、つもりだった、かも？: Ah, well, um, I guess I was planning to do that, maybe?
m920205.あーあー、また悩んでる。\nそういうのやめるんじゃなかったの？:
Ah, ah, here we go again.
Didn't you say you'd stop doing that?
m920205.い、いったい、どうしたのですか！？\nあの雷撃があった直後に、\n「戦力をかき集:
W-What is going on?!
Right after that lightning strike,
you told us to "gather all our strength and follow you to the death"?!
m920205.いいえ、そんなことはさせません。\nそうでしょう、王子？:
No, I won't let that happen.
Won't you, Prince?
m920205.いいえ、ひとりではありません。: No, it is not just one person.
m920205.いいえ、もうひとつの手段があります。: No, there is one other method.
m920205.いいや、まだだ！\nここで散れ、亜神ディアスッ！！:
No, not yet!

Perish here, Lesser God Dias!!
m920205.いかなる神であれど、創造神の座には及ばない。\nされど、唯一の例外がここにある。:
No god, however mighty, can rival the seat of the Creator.

Yet, here lies the sole exception.
m920205.いくらひい爺さ……ディアスでも、\nオリュンポスから物質界全土に、\nあの雷撃を:
Even my gr… Dias,
couldn't unleash that kind of lightning
from Olympus across the entire material world.
m920205.いけない、早く起きないと……。\n王子がいない間、王国を守るのは、私の……。:
No, I must wake up soon…
While the Prince is away, it is my duty to protect the kingdom…
m920205.いたたたたたた！？\nなにするんでひゅかー！？:
Ow ow ow ow ow!?

What do you think you're doing, hyuka!?
m920205.いつまで諦めずにいられるのか、見せてみよ。: Then show me how long you can hold on without giving up.
m920205.いや、お前はまず、こちらで戦うつもりだろう。\n娘の考えくらい、父にはわかるもの:
No, I assume you intend to fight on this side first.
A father can tell what his daughter is thinking.
m920205.いや、喜んでいる場合じゃないよ！\n僕はともかく、皆どうやって戻れば――:
No, this isn't the time to be cheering!
Setting aside what I'll do, how is everyone else going to get back――
m920205.いや、痛み分けだ。\nこの世界で初めて、余に刃を届かせた男、だな。:
No, it was a draw.
He is the first man in this world to land a blow on me.
m920205.う、うるさいにゃ。\nあたまにガンガン響くにゃ……。:
Shh, hush now.
My head is pounding terribly…
m920205.うぅぅぅぅぅぅぅぅ。\nあたしの！ 負け！ あたしが負けました！ もー！！:
Uuuuuuuuuu.
It's mine! I lost! I, Persenas, lost! Ugh!!
m920205.うぅん、あたしが知りたいのは正義の真理。\n信じたものを砕かれてなお、\n別の正:
Mm, what I want to know is the truth of justice.
The way one can believe in a different justice
even after the one they believed in is shattered.
m920205.うるさいな……そっちだって今さら正義面？\nぜんっぜん似合ってないよ！ 不良ひ孫:
Shut up… You're putting on that righteous act now?
It suits you not at all! You delinquent granddaughter!
m920205.うん……分かった。\nところで――えっと、\n戦いが終わった後にも、またお話、で:
I see…… I understand.
By the way――um,
will I be able to talk with you again after the battle is over?
m920205.えぇ、もっと早く教えてほしかったわ。\n――いえ、もっと早く、自分で気付くべきだ:
Yes, I wish you had told me sooner.
――No, I should have realized it on my own.
m920205.えぇ、任せたわ。: Yes, I leave it to you.
m920205.えぇ、私は死にました。\nその身を神の楔に変え、あなたたちをここに送るために。:

I turned my body into a divine wedge to send you all here.
m920205.えっ、えぇと、天空、ですか？ あの、ケラウノス様！？: Huh? Uh, the sky? I mean, Lady Keraunos!?
m920205.お、王子くん！ 戦闘準備を！\nクロノシアは――試練を授けるつもりです！！:
P-Prince! Prepare for battle!
Chronosia intends to bestow a trial upon us!!
m920205.おいおい、今度は空に航海か？: Well, well, sailing through the sky now, are we?

Hey, hey, now isn't the time to let your guard down.
After all, we only just managed to avoid a complete defeat
from what was set to be a total loss.
m920205.おぉ、シビラ姫。\nソンナに急いで、イッタイどうしたノダ？:
Oh, Princess Sybilla.
What's the rush? What's going on?
m920205.おそらくは、時間を何度も飛び越えて、\n神獣との縁を綴織のように、\n世界に編み:
You likely leaped through time countless times,
weaving your bond with the divine beast into the world
like a tapestry.
m920205.お前たちを救ってやろう。\nようやく、クロノシアより奪った力も、\n身体に馴染み:
Let me save you.
The power I seized from Chronosia
is finally beginning to take root in my body.
m920205.お前の可能性を！\n人の未来を！ 余に見せてみよ！:
Show me your potential!
Show me the future of humankind!
m920205.お前の計画の邪魔になるものを、\nどれだけその手にかけた、いくつの命を奪った！:
How many things that stood in the way of your plan

m920205.お前を殺し、その命と魔力の全てを余が受け継ぐ。\nそれをもって、物質界に永遠の安:
I will kill you and inherit all of your life and magic.

m920205.かつて、我が父ディアスの力は分かたれ、\n三柱の女神となった。:
Long ago, the power of my father Zeus was divided,
and became three goddesses.
m920205.かわりに、その加護のせいで\n戦意が削がれているんだけどね――って、あれ？:
On the other hand, that blessing is sapping our fighting spirit—
wait, what is that?
m920205.きみたちを蹴散らすのは、正義たるこのあたし。\n誰も悲しまない世界で、\n大人し:
It is this self-proclaimed justice of mine who will trample you all into the dirt.
In a world where no one has to grieve,
just accept your defeat and fade away quietly!!

m920205.きみには関係ない。\nそれより王子、もうなりふり構っている暇はない。\nきみの力:
It's none of your concern.
Besides, Prince, we don't have time to stand on ceremony.
Lend me your power!
m920205.くそっ、くそっ、あーもう！\n好きにしろ！ 勝手にしろぉ！！:
Dammit, dammit, ugh!
Do whatever you want! Go ahead!!
m920205.くっ……ああ、そうだよ！\nさぁ王子、とにかく急げ！\n要塞宮殿の麓まで、あと少:
Tsk… yeah, you're right!
Come on, Prince, let's hurry!
We're almost at the foot of the Fortress Palace!
m920205.くっ……こんな雷ごときで……っ！\n……ッ、くそっ、変身が――:
Tsk… a lightning strike like this…!
…Gh, damn it, my transformation is—
m920205.けっ、また悪役面しやがって……。: Tch, putting on that villain face again...
m920205.ここから先は、私に任せて。\nゴブリン博士たちは離脱を！:
Leave the rest to me.
Goblin Doctor, you and the others, fall back!
m920205.ここにいるのは、遥かな未来の私が「そうする」と、\n未来視によって知った、過去の:
The one here is my past self, whom I, in the distant future,

m920205.ここに集いしは、すべての時代に生きた戦士の魂。\n生きることを願い、抗った者たち:
Gathered here are the souls of warriors who lived across all ages.
It is the will of those who desired to live and defied their fate!
m920205.この世界は創造神の生み出したもの。\n諦めない彼の意志が、世界を少しだけ、書き換:
This world was created by the Creator God.

m920205.この愛が、創造神の座を引き継いだがゆえの\n義務から来るものであることは否定しな:

But even so, I do not wish to see this world perish.
m920205.この時代から鍛えまくって、\n数千、いや、数万年後？\nのディアスを倒せるくらい:
Train relentlessly from this era,

and become strong enough to defeat Dias

thousands, no, tens of thousands of years from now……?

The sound of those wings…
Everyone, watch out for the sky!
m920205.これが終わったら、どんな罰だって――: When this is over, whatever punishment you want—
m920205.これだから脳筋きらいにゃぁぁぁぁ！！: This is why I hate muscle heads!!!!
m920205.これは……。\n……見たことが、あります。:
This is……
I've seen this before.
m920205.ごめんなさい、無理をさせてしまったわね。: I'm sorry. I pushed you too hard, didn't I?
m920205.さぁ、再誕が始まる。\n誰も悲しまず、凪のように穏やかな時代が。:
Now, the rebirth begins.

An era where no one mourns, calm as a still sea.
m920205.さぁ王子、きみの力を見せて！\n本物のあたしの神器と、\nまがい物のきみの神器、:
Now then, Prince, show me what you've got!
The real divine artifact, and your counterfeit one—

m920205.さぁ王子、君の答えを見せてもらおうかな。: Come now, Prince. Show me your answer.
m920205.さっき言ったとおりさ。\nあいつは、ペルセナスは、天界の英雄なんだ。:
Just as I said before.
That guy, Persenas, is a hero of the heavens.
m920205.さて、どうでしょう。\nまたいつ、何をきっかけにして、\n私が本来のあり方に戻る:
Well, who knows.
I have no idea when, or what will cause,
me to revert to my true nature.
m920205.されど、創造神の継承者たる余が、\n滅びの要因たる彼らを\n絶滅させることなど、:
Yet, as the successor to the Creator God,
I am powerless to exterminate
the very cause of that destruction.
m920205.しかし、それも完全ではないようだ。\nクロノシア、貴様の魔力の欠片は受け取った。:
But it seems you are not yet complete.
Chronosia, I have received the fragment of your mana.
m920205.じゃあもう、遠慮はしない。\n本気の、全力の、全神器で！\n勝ち続けることにのみ:
Then I won't hold back.
With my full strength, all my divine artifacts!
I'll prove that only in continuing to win lies justice!
m920205.じゃあもうひとつ見せてあげようかな。\n物質界の英雄くん？:
How about I show you one more thing?
Oh, hero of the material world?

m920205.そう、だから、戦ってみたかったんだ。\n常勝を誓ったあたしと、不敗を誓ったきみで:
Yes. That's why I wanted to fight.
Between me, who swore to always win,
and you, who swore to never lose!
m920205.そう、ですね……。\n安心してちゃだめでした。:
That's right…
We can't afford to relax.
m920205.そう、わずかでも、\n物質界の可能性を見せてくれるかと思ったのだがな。\n貴様に:
Yes, I thought you might show me, even if only a little,
the potential of the material world.
Was I wrong to have expected anything from you?
m920205.そう言われて、素直に立ち止まると思う？: And you expect us to just stop because you say so?
m920205.そこまでして、知りたいのかよ。\n自分の中の正義の形ってやつを。:
You really want to know that badly?
About the shape of the justice within yourself.
m920205.そして、余がこの計画を始めることも。: And that I would begin this plan.
m920205.そして女神アイギスは、\n人の王に、己の権能を宿した武具を与えた。:
And the goddess Aegis
bestowed upon the King of Men a weapon imbued with her authority.
m920205.そのために、どれだけのものを犠牲にするつもりだ！: How many things do you intend to sacrifice for that!
m920205.その刃は神をも殺しうる！\nその可能性は、世界すら斬り裂くだろう！！:
That blade can slay even a god!
That potential could tear the world itself apart!!
m920205.その原因を、根本から消し去ろうというのだぞ。: I intend to eradicate the root cause of all that.
m920205.その娘は、もうこちら側でしょう。\n王子の記憶の中ではそうなっていましたが？:
That girl is on our side now, isn't she?
At least, that's how it was in the Prince's memories.
m920205.その時に、理解してしまったのです。\n人は愚かであれど、まだ可能性を残した存在だ:
At that moment, I understood.
Even if humans are foolish, they are still beings with potential.
m920205.その盾に映した物語を、再演するもの。\nこれなるは亜神ディアスより授かりし、鏡映:
A vessel that reenacts the story reflected in it.
This is the Mirror Shield, bestowed by the sub-deity Dias.
m920205.その神獣の名は、エインヘリヤル。\n遥かな未来で歪み、壊れてしまう前の、\n純粋:
The name of that divine beast is Einherjar.
It is the pure form of the souls of warriors,
before they were warped and broken in the distant future.
m920205.その要塞宮殿ができると、どうなるの？: What happens when that Fortress Palace is finished?
m920205.その迷いも、今日までです。\nあなたの計画を、看過することはできません。:
That confusion ends today.
I cannot allow your plan to proceed unchecked.
m920205.それじゃあ、ひい爺さんの所へ行かせてもらうぜ。\n世界を、救わないといけないから:
Well then, I'm going to see my grandpa.
I have to save the world, you know!
m920205.それだけじゃなさそうだけどね？\nそんなに嬉しそうな顔、初めてみたし。:
That doesn't seem to be the only reason, does it?
I've never seen you look so happy before.
m920205.それでは、あなた方を未来に――: Then, I shall send you all to the future――
m920205.それなら、いいかしら。\nところで、私に試練というのは――:
Then, that works for me.
By the way, a trial for me—
m920205.それならさ、やっぱりあたしが出なくちゃ♪: If that's the case, I really should be the one to step in♪
m920205.それに、正義はこっちにもあるんだから。\n正義と正義の戦いで、あっちには\n「女:
Besides, justice is on our side too.
In a clash of just causes, the other side even has
“the Goddess Aigis's favorite,” right?
m920205.それはあなたも同じこと。\n互いに神になりそこねましたね？:
The same can be said for you.
We both failed to become gods, didn't we?
m920205.それも含めて、いつもどおりですよ。: That's part of the usual routine, too.
m920205.それを止めようと、\nお前が時間稼ぎをしていたわけじゃな。: So that is why you were stalling for time.
m920205.そんなことばかりしてるから、\nアスガルドは……みんなは……！:
Because you're always doing things like that,
Asgard is…… everyone is……!
m920205.そんな戦闘用の神器で固めておいて、よく言うぜ。\n戦ってぶちのめすための装備じゃ:
You say that with all that combat-oriented divine equipment?
It's clearly gear meant for fighting and crushing your opponents.
m920205.ただ、ひとつだけ、間違いようのない真理がある。\n敗北はね、全ての正義を台無しに:
But there is one truth that cannot be wrong.
Defeat ruins all justice.
m920205.ただ、他にも理由がある、っていうのも正解。: But it's also true that there are other reasons.
m920205.ただ、急いでいこうにも、移動手段が……。: But even if I want to hurry, I don't have a way to travel……
m920205.ただ、私としても、これは誤算だったのですが……。: However, this was an miscalculation on my part…
m920205.たとえば、アイギスが人類を愛するように、\nディアスもまた、人類を愛しています。:
For example, just as Aigis loves humanity,
Dias also loves humanity.
m920205.だからね、ずっと気になってたんだ。\n負けたくせに、王子の味方面して、\n一緒に:
That's why I've always been curious.
About the feelings of those who, despite losing,
still stand by the Prince's side and play at being righteous.
m920205.だから喧嘩は待てと言っておろう！\nイコルにも事情があったんじゃ。\nそれに今は:
I told you to save the bickering for later!
Ikol had his reasons.
Besides, right now, we need every bit of strength we can get.
m920205.だから急がないと……ちくしょう。\n俺のせいだ、俺がうじうじと悩んでたから……。:
So we don't have time to spare… damn it.
It's my fault. I was just moping around, hesitating…
m920205.だが――余もまた、世界を担う義務があるッ！！: But――I, too, bear the duty to uphold the world!!
m920205.だが、これが輝きか。\n余の見たかった、信じたかったものか。:
But this is what radiance is.
This is what I wished to see, what I wished to believe.
m920205.だが、その憎しみも、悲しみも、\nあと少しで永遠に消え去る。:
But that hatred, that sorrow,
will vanish forever in just a little while.
m920205.だが、その死にかけた身体で何ができる。: But what can you do with that body on the brink of death?
m920205.だが、それでも……なぜだ。\nそこまでの決意をもってなお、\nなぜ余に届かない。:
And yet… why.
Even with that level of resolve,
why can't you reach me? Why do you fall short?
m920205.だが、事実あの雷撃はアイギス神殿に届いた！\nつまり……要塞宮殿の完成が近いって:
But that lightning reached the Aegis Temple!
Which means… the Fortress Palace is nearly complete!
m920205.だが、誰かに委ねた世界もまた、\n人からすれば、滅びと変わらないものだ。:
But a world entrusted to someone else is no different
from destruction, as far as humans are concerned.
m920205.ったく、最後までしまらねぇな。\nお前いつもそうだよな、ペルセナス。:
Tsk, you never change, even at the end.
That's just how you are, Persenas.
m920205.って、おい！\n俺様の上からどけ半神女！: Hey, get off me, you half-goddess!
m920205.で、どこから突き崩してやればいいんで？\n敵さんもなりふり構っていないようですが: So, where do we start smashing them? The enemy isn't exactly holding back.
m920205.ですが、私は――この世界に流れる悠久の時は、\nあなたを信じます、王子。:
But I——and the eternal time that flows through this world——
believe in you, Prince.
m920205.では、あなたたちは、\n天空に至る手段でも考えておきなさい。\n私はしばし、神殿:
Now then, you all
had better start thinking of a way to reach the sky.
I shall retreat to the temple for a while.
m920205.では、未来の私をよろしくお願いします。\n未来の――王たる――:
Then, please take care of my future self.
The future――the King――
m920205.では、異存はないということで。: Then, I take it there are no objections.
m920205.とにかく雑兵を蹴散らして、\n一刻も早くディアスを叩くしかない。: We just need to sweep aside the grunts and strike at Dias as soon as possible.
m920205.どういうことですか。\nどうしてあなたが、こんな所に。:
What does that mean?
Why are you here?
m920205.どうやって、あんな場所まで？\n帝国の飛空戦艦でも届かないぞ。:
How would we even get to a place like that?
Even the Empire's flying battleships can't reach it.
m920205.どうやら、無事に全員転送できたようですね。: It seems everyone has been transported safely.
m920205.どうやら夢ではなく、現実のようです。: It seems this is not a dream, but reality.
m920205.どちらが神になるのか！\n創造神を継ぐのか！ お前の誓いを見せてみよ！！:
Which of us will become the god!
Who will inherit the Creator! Show me the strength of your oath!!
m920205.どんどん行くよ！\n王子、きみも隠し事はなしなし！\n全部見せて、きみの戦い方を:
I'm going all out!
Prince, no more secrets!
Show me everything, your true fighting style!
m920205.な、な、なんですかあれ！\nゴルゴーンがどこからともなく！:
W-What is that!
A Gorgon out of nowhere!
m920205.なっ……あれは、ペガサス！？\nいったいどこから！:
Wha… is that a Pegasus?!
Where did it even come from!
m920205.なっ……何だ、この魔力は、いったいどこから。\nまさか、女神の身体そのものを神の: Wha— What is this power? Where is it coming from? No way… using the goddess's body itself as a divine wedge—
m920205.なにをー！？ そっちも半神でしょ！\n負け犬裏切り者女ー！:
What are you――? You're a half-god too!
You loser, you traitor!
m920205.なるほど、その剣は……。\nようやく、もうひとつの剣を見出したのですね。:
I see, that sword is…….
At last, you have found the other blade.
m920205.なんだ、簡単じゃん！\nつまり天墜神星さまの彗星を、\n何百発も耐えるようなもの:
Oh, that's easy!
So it's just like enduring hundreds of
Tensuishinsei-sama's comets, right?
m920205.なんで、何も言わないの？\n負けた時に恥ずかしいから？:
Why are you saying nothing?
Are you too embarrassed to speak after losing?
m920205.はぁ……これが、敗北、かぁ……。\nめちゃくちゃ悔しい、\n死ぬほど悔しい、ぶっ:
Haa…… So this is what defeat feels like…….
I'm so frustrated,
I'm dying of frustration, I want to kill someone.
m920205.はぁ、また口ばっかり！\nそれに何なんですか、その下手な変装。\n魔界ガード？:
Hah, all talk and no action!
And what is that terrible disguise?
Demon Realm Guard? King's Guard? Are you playing dress-up?
m920205.ふっざけんなよ、お前がそんな真面目なタマかよ！\nいい加減に、そこを、どけぇぇぇ:
Cut the crap, you're not the type to get all serious!
Get out of the way, right now!!
m920205.ふっふっふ、口元、すっごい嬉しそうに笑ってるよぉ？: Fu fu fu, your smile is absolutely radiant, you know?
m920205.ふふっ、えぇ、分かったわ。\nきっとまた、お話しましょう、ご先祖さま。:
Hehe, yes, I understand.
We will surely talk again, ancestor.
m920205.ふふっ、えぇ、確かに。\nタカマガハラの神々よ、私たちに、どうかお力を！:
Heh, yes, indeed.
O gods of Takamagahara, please lend us your strength!
m920205.ふふっ、そうだよ。\n敗北した正義に価値はない！\nだからあたしは、守るために勝:
Heh, you're right.
There's no value in a justice that loses!
So I keep winning, to protect what matters!
m920205.ふふっ、たったそれだけの魔力では、\nあなたの要塞宮殿は安定しませんよ？:
Heh, with just that little mana,
your fortress palace won't remain stable, will it?
m920205.ふふっ、なんだ、それならいつもどおりですね？: Fufu, well, isn't that just like us?
m920205.ふふん、いいねいいね！\n不敗を誓うだけあるよ！:
Hehe, not bad, not bad!
Just as I'd expect from someone who swears to never lose!
m920205.ふふん、嘘は言ってないのになぁ。\n正義のために戦ってるのはホントだよ。:
Hehe, and I'm not even lying.
I really am fighting for justice.
m920205.へぇ……珍しい。\nでも一応、勝ったんだよね？:
Hm… that's rare.
But you did win, right?
m920205.へぇ、分かる子がいるんだ。: Oh, so you can sense it.
m920205.へぇ、物質界にも伝わってるの？\nふふーん、嬉しいなぁ！\nそれで、他にはどんな:
Huh, so word has reached the Material World?
Fufu~ how nice!
So, what other legends have been passed down?
m920205.へっへっへ、正解♪\n何しろ興味があるからね。:
Heh heh heh, correct♪
I'm just really interested, after all.
m920205.ほう……？\nお前はアスガルドの者を憎んでいたと思ったが。:
Hm…?
I thought you hated those of Asgard.
m920205.ほう、良い呼び名だ。\n創造神を名乗るのも、先達に不敬だと思っていたところだ。\: Hm, a fitting title. I had been thinking it was an act of disrespect to the predecessors to claim the name of Creator God. From this moment on, I shall be known as the Great God.
m920205.ほんとなに！？ みんな分かったような顔して！！: Seriously? You're all making those knowing faces!!
m920205.ま、ま、待ってください！\n確かに、私ではなく、ダークアンナさんは\n神獣ニーズ:
W-wait a moment!
It's true that Dark Anna, not me,
was the one who commanded the divine beast Nidhogg, but……
m920205.ま、待ってください！\n事情を説明してほしいのですが！:
W-wait a moment!
Please, we need an explanation!
m920205.まだ要塞宮殿が完成形でないことだけが救いだ。\n先の雷撃の後、\n二発目の充填に:
The only saving grace is that the fortress isn't fully complete yet.
After that lightning strike,
it seems he's taking a while to recharge for the next one.
m920205.まてまてまて！ ハリンヘイム、待て！\n痴話喧嘩はいつでもできる！\nイコル、も:
Wait, wait, wait! Harinheim, hold on!
We can bicker about this later!
Ikol, we're out of time, aren't we?!
m920205.もう二度と、何も、失わせはしないわ。: I won't let you lose anything ever again.
m920205.もう休め、楽になれ。\nお前の剣では、余に決して届かぬ。\nこの戦いをもって、そ:
Rest now. Find peace.
Your sword will never reach me.
Through this battle, I have come to understand that.
m920205.もとより、私は人の世を終わらせる存在でした。\n物質界の生命が愚かな行いをしたな:
I was always meant to be the one to end the human world.
If the life of the material world commits foolishness,
it is my duty to condemn and destroy it.
m920205.やつが、クロノシアの封印を解いたら終わりだ。\nこちらの敗北が確定する。:
If he breaks Chronosia's seal, it's over.
Our defeat will be sealed.
m920205.やめろ師匠！ くっ、なんだ、この魔力は……！？: Stop it, Master! Ugh, what is this magic power……!?
m920205.よい、しょっと……。\n――おまたせ、王子。:
Right, here we go…….
――Sorry to keep you waiting, Prince.
m920205.よし、ここで勝負と行こうか。\n全力で戦うにふさわしい戦場でしょ？:
Alright, let's settle this here.
This is a worthy battlefield for a full-power fight, isn't it?
m920205.わぁ、さすが常勝不敗の王国軍。\nやっぱり正義っていうのはこうじゃないとね。:
Wow, just as expected of the undefeated Kingdom Army.
Right, this is how justice is supposed to work.
m920205.わかり易すぎて涙が出ちゃいそう……。\n全力で薙ぎ払うしかないみたいね。: It's so straightforward I'm almost in tears… Looks like we'll have to mow them all down.
m920205.わっ、投槍？\nアキレアちゃん、そんなのであたしに勝とうなんて、\nやっぱり負け:
Huh, a spear throw?
Achillea-chan, trying to beat me with that?
You really are a loser, aren't you――
m920205.ん、そうか……。\n敗北すべき者たちには、負けた理由を、\n諦める理由を提供して:
Hm, I see…
I suppose I should give those destined to lose a reason to lose,
and a reason to give up.
m920205.んぅ……。\nどうして起きられないのかしら……。:
Mmm…
Why can't I wake up…?
m920205.アキレアと話してると雰囲気ぶち壊しでしょ！？\nあーもう、ほら、王子も笑ってるじ:
Talking to Achillea ruins the atmosphere, doesn't it?!
Ah, geez, look, the Prince is laughing too!
m920205.アキレアは、自分の道を選んだ。\nこんな時だが、お前も好きにするといい。:
Achilles has chosen his own path.
It's a difficult time, but you may do as you please.
m920205.アキレアは納得してなかったみたいだけど、\nあたしは、世界が平和になるならそれで:
Achillea seemed unconvinced, but
I think it's fine if the world becomes peaceful.
m920205.アスガルドを焼き払った、魔力の奔流。\nあのときにそっくりです。\nこんなの……:
The torrent of magic that burned Asgard to the ground.
It's exactly the same as that time.
How could this…… how did this happen……?
m920205.アンナ、さん？\nあなたの力で、未来の私を守ってほしいのです。:
Anna, could you?
I want you to use your power to protect my future self.
m920205.アンナさん、あなたが神獣との縁を、\n複雑に絡み合った\n可能性の糸からつかみと:
Anna, just as you seized the thread of your bond with the divine beast
from a tangle of
possibilities――
m920205.イザ、行進開始ッ！\nゴブリン軍団の統制力ヲ見せつけヨ！！:
Now, begin the march!
Show the world the Goblin Legion's discipline!!
m920205.ウム、見習いモ育ちツツアル。\nゴブリン軍団ノ未来ハ明るいゾ！！:
Mm, the apprentice is growing up nicely.
The future of the Goblin Legion is bright!
m920205.エインヘリヤルとは、過去の魂ではありません。\n現在、過去、未来、すべての時代に:
Einherjar is not the soul of the past.
It is the vessel for the souls of noble warriors
who lived in all eras: present, past, and future.
m920205.エフトラちゃんが、生まれる前ということ、ですかぁ！？\n古代文明より前の時代に来:
So, before Ephtra-chan was born, huh!?

We've ended up in an era before the ancient civilizations……?
m920205.カツテは敵トシテ、世界を滅ぼさんとシ、\n此度は、世界を守ランとする英雄のモトへ:
Once, as an enemy, we sought to destroy the world.
Now, we bear the great task of leading the princess
to the hero who strives to protect it……!
m920205.ガリウスとの決戦以降、\n王子の魂の内にて眠っていたのですが、\nなんというのか:
Since the decisive battle with Gallius,
I had been sleeping within the Prince's soul,
but it seems I was… affected by something.
m920205.ギャギャ、ショーゴーカンリョー！\nジョーリクチテン！ ココ！ ココ！:
Gya-gya, show's over!
Journey's destination! Here! Here!
m920205.ククッ、ハハハハッ！ さぁこい、王子！\n余に物質界の可能性というものを見せてみ:
Kuk, hahahaha! Come, Prince!
Show me the possibilities of the material realm!!
m920205.クロノシア！\n良かった、無事で――いや、違う、のか？:
Chronosia!

I'm glad you're safe――wait, no, are you?
m920205.ケラウノスめ、借り物の雷霆で余を欺こうとは……。\nどこまでも気に入らぬ女神だ。:
Keraunos, trying to deceive me with borrowed thunder…
You are a goddess I can never stand.
m920205.ゴブリン博士、お願いがあるの。\n私を……天界まで、連れて行って。:
Goblin Doctor, I have a request.
Please take me…… to the Celestial Realm.
m920205.シビラ殿下！？\nどうしてここに！？:
Princess Sybilla!?
What are you doing here!?
m920205.デカシタ！\nシビラ姫ヨ、コノママ戦場ニ突撃スルゾ！:
Great job!
Princess Sybilla, let's charge into the battlefield as is!
m920205.フフフ……この時を待っていたゾ……。: Fufufu…… I've been waiting for this moment…….
m920205.ペルセナス、お前が興味を持っていた、あの男だ。: Persenas, it is the man you were so interested in.
m920205.ペルセナスの盾だけに気を取られるな。\n斧槍と剣は飛翔し、周囲を斬り裂いてくる。:
Don't let your guard down just because of Persenas's shield.
The axe-spear and sword will fly, slashing at everything around.
Harsh as it sounds—fight him as if you're battling the Prince himself!
m920205.ラムイエルよ、もはやこの者に価値はない。\n目覚めたばかりのお前でも十分だろう。:
Ramuel, this one has no value anymore.
You, who have just awakened, will be more than sufficient.
……Eliminate him.
m920205.リリア、下がって下さい。\nペルセナスの魔力が、急激に上昇しています。:
Lilia, step back.
Persenas's magic power is rising rapidly.
m920205.ワタクシの発明品デ、空のカナタ、\n青空のムコウ！ オリュンポスに強襲デアル！！:
With my inventions, we'll strike through the sky,
straight to Olympus!
m920205.一番危険な場所に飛び込んでいくの、\nいつも王子なんですけどね……。: It's always the Prince who rushes into the most dangerous spots…
m920205.万能の雷霆たる我が力と、\n時の女神の力を束ねたならば、\nそれは創造神の座にす:
If I were to combine my power, the omnipotent thunder,

with the power of the goddess of time,

it would be enough to reach even the Creator's seat.
m920205.三女神とは、権能だけでなく、\nそのあり方もまた、受け継いだ存在です。:
The Three Goddesses inherited not only their domains,
but also their very nature.
m920205.上空カラ、イキナリ放り出すカモトカ、\n思わなかったハズがないダロウ……？:
Throwing you out of the sky without warning…
You must have expected that, right…?
m920205.世界樹のビフロストか、帝国の飛空戦艦……？\nすぐ天界にかけつける手段なんて……:
Bifrost of the World Tree, or the Empire's airship……?
There's no way to reach the Celestial Realm right away……
m920205.久方ぶりにまみえた女神に、\nわざわざ確認をしないと分からないとは……。: To think I would have to confirm my identity with a goddess I haven't seen in so long…
m920205.亜神を超えた存在、神の座をも超えた……大神、ディアスか。: An existence beyond the Lesser Gods, beyond the seat of the gods… A Great God, Dias.
m920205.人に委ねれば、世界は滅びるのかもしれない。: If we leave it all to humans, the world may be destroyed.
m920205.人は、愚かなものだ。\n戦いを繰り返し、誰かを傷つけ、\n成長とは名ばかりの争い:
Humans are foolish creatures.
They repeat war, hurt one another,
and continue conflicts that are only called growth.
m920205.今の人類に、未来を委ねることはできぬ。\n奴らは成長と争いを取り違え、\nいずれ:
I cannot entrust the future to humanity as it stands.
They mistake conflict for growth,
and one day, they will burn this world to the ground.
m920205.今は、試練に挑んでいる時間はないのだけれど……。: I don't have the time to face a trial right now, though…
m920205.今回は、その体質――いえ、運命を利用させてください。\nあなたに、神獣の加護を授:
This time, let me make use of that constitution――no, that destiny.
I will grant you the protection of the divine beast.
m920205.任されヨ、シビラ姫！\n必ず、王子のモトへお連れシヨウ！:
Leave it to us, Princess Sybilla!
We will surely bring you to the Prince!
m920205.何……？\n魔力吸収が、止まった……？\n人間ひとりの力ごときで……！:
What…?
My mana absorption has stopped…?
With the power of a mere human…!
m920205.何、これから奪い取れば済むことだ。\nまずは人間、エインヘリヤルを使役する貴様か:
Bah, I'll simply take it from you later.
First, let me end the life of you who command humans and Einherjar.
m920205.何が――っ！ 関係ないって、どういう意味ですか！\nあなたはいつも！ いつもそう:
What—! None of my concern? What does that mean?!
You always do this! Always like this!!
m920205.何だ、その力は。\nアイギスの神器――いや、女神の力は感じぬ。\n貴様の内より湧:
What is that power?
I sense no Aigis artifact――no, no divine power.
What is this radiance rising from within you!
m920205.余が目覚めしその時こそ、\nこの世界に、永遠の平穏が訪れるときだ――。:
When I awaken,
that shall be the moment eternal peace descends upon this world――.
m920205.余に可能性を見せるのではなかったのか。\nさぁ、その刃を神に突き立ててみせるがい:
You were going to show me your potential, weren't you?
Then come, drive that blade into a god!
m920205.余の計画に……真っ向から抗う者ばかり、か……。: So many who defy my plans head-on, I see…
m920205.余は、いま、確かに歓喜している。: I am truly rejoicing, right now.
m920205.余は、人類を愛している。\n当人たちからすれば、無用な愛ではあろうが。:
I love humanity.
To them, it is likely an unnecessary affection.
m920205.作戦はまとまったな。\n行くぞ、王子。ここで亜神ディアスを仕留めるッ！！: The plan is set. Let's go, Prince. We'll finish off the Lesser God Dias right here!!
m920205.俺様は最初から正義の味方だばかやろぉぉぉッ！！: I've been on the side of justice from the start, you idiot!!
m920205.元は、同一の存在でしょう？: Originally, weren't you both the same being?
m920205.再びあの力が必要になった時には、\n称号を「誓いの英雄」とすればよいでしょう。\:
Should you ever need that power again,
you may take the title of "Hero of the Oath."
Your past will never betray you.
m920205.出し惜しみはしないよ！\nさぁ王子、挑んでくるのは、きみの方だ！:
I won't hold anything back!
Come on, Prince, it's your turn to make your move!
m920205.創造神ともあろう者が、\nこれほどまでに愚かな生命を生み出すものかと！:
I could not believe a being like the Creator God
would bring forth such foolish life!
m920205.創造神なきこの世界を受け継ぎ、\nその未来の全てを担うのは、我が使命なのだからな:
To inherit this world, now that the Creator God is gone,
and bear the weight of its entire future is my mission.
m920205.助かる、徐華。\nそうだ、ヤツはクロノシア――時の女神の封印を\n破るだけの要塞:
Thanks, Xuhua.
So, he's already obtained enough of the fortress palace's power to break Chronosia's seal.
m920205.勝たなくちゃ、正義をなすことはできない。\nだからあたしは、絶対に誰も悲しまない:
If you can't win, you can't uphold justice.
That's why I decided to protect a world where no one has to be sad,
with my own hands♪
m920205.勝利を勝ち取り、友の背中を支えルタメ！\n行進訓練～ッ！ 準備ッ！！:
To secure victory and support our comrades!
Marching drill~! Ready!!
m920205.千の誓いが、千の約束が、\n過去のすべてが、俺を支えてくれている。:
A thousand vows, a thousand promises,
all of the past, they are supporting me.
m920205.問題は、その威力があれば、\n眠ってるヤバイ女神の封印を破れるってことだ。:
The problem is that with that kind of power,
he can break the seal on the dangerous goddess who's sleeping.
m920205.嘆き、恨み、殺し、奪い合うのみの人類が、\n本当に創造神の被造物であるのかと、\:
I had always wondered whether humanity,
a race of nothing but lamentation, hatred, murder, and strife,
was truly the creation of the Creator God…….
m920205.外のゴブリン博士から通信のようです。\n魔術ギルドの通信網に割り込むとは……。\:
It seems to be a communication from the Goblin Doctor outside.
To break into the Magic Guild's communication network…
Hello? Is something wrong?
m920205.大正解！\nそういうわけだから、\nきみたちは、この先に進ませない。:
Correct!
And because of that,
you are not to pass this point.
m920205.大神ディアス……。\nそうか、クロノシアの呪いを解いたのか！:
Great God Dias……
So that's it. You've broken Chronosia's curse!
m920205.天界の加護――敵も味方も関係なく\n体力を癒やす力が、今はありがたいですね。\n:
The blessing of the heavens—it heals our vitality,
regardless of whether we're friend or foe.
It's a great help right now.
Even after sprinting at full speed this far, I seem to be holding up.
m920205.天界デハ、今モ王子タチが戦ってイル。\n我々モ、物質界連合軍の一員とシテ、\n訓:
In the Celestial Realm, the Princes are still fighting.
As members of the Material World Coalition,
we must not slacken our training!
m920205.姉さま、私たちの命を燃やせば――: Sister, if we burn our lives away—
m920205.姿隠しの神器、か！\n気にするな王子、捕まえちまえば問題ない！:
A concealment divine artifact, is it!
Don't worry, Prince. Once we pin him down, it's no big deal!
m920205.実に哀れなものだ。\n弱き者同士で傷の舐め合いとは。:
How pitiful.
Two weak ones licking each other's wounds.
m920205.届かなければ、物質界は――いや、\nこの世界すべては、終わりだ。: If we can't, the Material World—no, this entire world—is finished.
m920205.師匠、無事か……？\nちっ……どうすりゃいいんだ、あんなヤツ……。:
Master, are you okay…?
Tch… What do we do against someone like that…?
m920205.弱くなったな、亜神イコル。: You have grown weak, demi-god Ikol.
m920205.強襲ヨウイ！\nシビラ姫、全力で駆け抜けるノダ。\n運命ガ――王子ガッ、アナタの:
Surprise attack, Sybilla!
Run with everything you've got!
Destiny is―― the Prince is―― he's waiting for you!!
m920205.当然よ……。\nだって、あらゆる法則は、\nこの世界の理はいま、ディアスの手にあ:
Of course…
After all, all laws,
the very principles of this world, are now in Dias's hands.
m920205.待って、聖剣を授かったって、あなたは――！: Wait, you received a holy sword? You are—!
m920205.待っているだけで、答えまで連れて行ってはくれない。\n自分で答えのある場所まで、:
Just waiting won't bring the answer to you.
You have to walk to the place where the answer lies.
m920205.後れを取った。\n余の慢心が招いたものだ。:
I was caught off guard.
It was my own arrogance that brought this on.
m920205.心躍る冒険も、強敵との戦いも、\n誰かの涙を拭うことより重要なわけないじゃん。:
Exciting adventures, battles against powerful foes—
none of that is more important than wiping away someone's tears.
m920205.心配して損した！\n諦めてないどころか、完全勝利確信しちゃってるじゃん♪:
I worried for nothing!
You're not just holding on; you're completely confident in total victory♪
m920205.心配しないで。\n今回は、不意打ちじゃない。\nこっちにも、いくつも対抗策がある:
Don't worry.
This time, we're not being caught off guard.
We have several countermeasures ready.
m920205.怖れることはありません。\nたかだか戦場全域の大火力攻撃です。:
There is no need to fear.
It is merely a massive bombardment across the entire battlefield.
m920205.思い返してみれば、お前には見えていたのだろうな。\n魔王を名乗るガリウスが世界を:
Looking back, you must have seen it all, didn't you?
That Garius, who calls himself the Demon King, would devour the world.
And that a prince, a mere human, would slay him.
m920205.思ってもないことを……。\nてめぇは馬鹿だが、悪役って器じゃねぇだろ！:
You're saying things you don't mean…
You're an idiot, but you're no villain!
m920205.恨めよ、クロノシア。\nだが、貴様の死を決して無駄にはしない。:
Hold a grudge, Chronosia.

But I will never let your death go to waste.
m920205.愚かしい。\nやはり人は愚かでどうしようもない存在ですね。:
How foolish.
Humans truly are hopeless.
m920205.愚かな存在にしては、上出来です。: Not bad, for such a foolish existence.
m920205.愚かな被造物の中にも、\nほんの少しでも、輝けるものがあったか！:
Even among foolish creations,
there was something that could shine, even if only a little!
m920205.我が武具は、父たるディアスより授かりしもの。\n奇遇だね、起源を同じくする神器の:
My weapon was bestowed by my father Zeus.
What a coincidence, that the bearers of divine artifacts with the same origin
would clash like this!
m920205.我ラ、ゴブリン軍団結成カラはや十年……。\nソノ実力モ、我ラの結束モ、\nヨリ強:
It has been ten years since the Goblin Legion was formed……
Our strength and our unity
have become even more solid!
m920205.戦いの中で、貴様の力が増していくのが分かる。\n原因は何だ、あの娘の聖剣か？\n:
I can feel your strength growing with every battle.
What is the cause? That girl's holy sword?
The prayers of the demi-gods? The goddess Aigis's blessing?
m920205.手綱の神器、か……。\n王子、突撃に気をつけろ！:
A reins divine artifact, I see…
Prince, watch out for the charge!
m920205.敗者に正義はない。\nでも、誰も負けないし、誰も勝たないなら、\n世界はそれで平:
There is no justice for the defeated.
But if no one loses and no one wins,
then the world will be peaceful, right?
m920205.時を止めた今となっては、\nその続きを、お前が見ることもあるまい。:
Now that time has stopped,
you will never see what happens next.
m920205.曰く、半神にして天界の英雄。\n荒ぶる亜神を鎮めし、偉大なる戦士――:
They are said to be a demigod and a hero of the Celestial Realm.
A great warrior who quelled the raging Lesser Gods――
m920205.次から次へと……今度はなんなんですかぁ！？: One thing after another… what is that now?!
m920205.正義っていうのはね、無限にあるんだよ。\nそしてきっと、それぞれに正解と間違いが:
You see, justice is infinite.
And surely, each version has its own right and wrong.
m920205.滅びだとは、思ってないからだよ。\nそれに、世界の趨勢より気になることがあるから:
Because I don't think of it as destruction.
Besides, there are things that concern me more than the world's trends.
m920205.無理をするな、とは言いませんが……。\nちゃんと生きて戻ってきてくださいね。\n: I won't say don't push yourself, but… please come back to us safely. We'll take care of any injuries.
m920205.然り。\n我が手の届かぬ場所はなく、我が目の届かぬ場所もない。: Indeed. There is no place beyond my reach, no place hidden from my gaze.
m920205.物質界か？ 人類か？\n争いばかりを繰り返す、愚かな者たちか？\nそれとも、もは:
The material world? Humanity?
Those fools who only know how to fight?
Or perhaps your homeland, which no longer exists?
m920205.王子、あなたの背中は、私が守るから。: Prince, I will guard your back.
m920205.王子、あの時の力は、\n既にあなたの中に宿っているはずです。:
Prince, that power from before
should already be dwelling within you.
m920205.王子、きみなら答えられるよね？\n物質界をすくい続けたきみなら、答えを持っている:
Prince, you can answer, right?
You who have kept saving the Material Realm must have the answer.
m920205.王子、きみも分かってるんでしょ？\nこの盾が、いかなるものなのか。:
Prince, you know too, don't you?
What this shield truly is.
m920205.王子、そして皆さん、\n今の私を助けてくれたこと、感謝します。\nただ、のんびり:
Prince, and everyone,
thank you for helping me just now.
However, it seems we don't have time for a leisurely greeting.
m920205.王子、気をつけてください。\nあの盾がアイギス様の神器と同じ権能を持つなら、\n:
Prince, be careful.
If that shield holds the same authority as Goddess Aegis's artifact,
it must possess a powerful defensive power in close combat…
m920205.王子、遥かな過去を想いなさい。\n伝説より、神話よりも古き時代を――: Prince, think of the distant past. An age older than legend, older than myth—
m920205.王子が僅かながらにも、世界を書き換えたあの時。\n私の内にも、王子の意志と共に、:
When the Prince rewrote the world, however slightly,
an immense amount of magical power returned to me,
along with the Prince's will.
m920205.王子くん、ペガサスに騎乗しても、\nあの盾の持つ、白兵戦での\n強力な防護の権能:
Prince, even if you mount the Pegasus,
the shield's powerful defensive authority
in close combat remains unchanged!
m920205.王子くんが聞いたら、\nきっと苦笑いするはず――おっと、\n本当に苦笑いしてまし:
If the Prince heard that,
he'd probably let out a wry smile――oh,
he actually did.
m920205.王子の誓いは、ただひとりのものじゃない。\n現在、過去、未来、すべての時代に生き:
The Prince's vow is not his alone.
The vows of every warrior who has lived
across the present, the past, and the future
are here, right now.
m920205.王子は、そんな見え透いた嫌がらせなんて\nできる男じゃないさ。:
The Prince is not the kind of man
who would resort to such transparent spite.
m920205.王子よ、お前は創造神の被造物の中で、\n唯一我が足元までたどり着いた稀有な存在だ:
Prince, you are a rare existence among the Creator's creations,

the only one to have reached my feet.

Therefore, I grant you permission to witness the rebirth of the world.
m920205.王子を延命させる方法は、いくつかあるが。: There are a few ways to extend the Prince's life.
m920205.王子を逃がす時間くらいは、作れるわね。\nでも、そこまでよ。: We can buy enough time to let the Prince escape. But that's all we can do.
m920205.真正面からぶつかるなってことですか。\nやりにくい相手ですね、まったく！:
So we can't just charge head-on, huh.
He's a tough opponent to deal with, really!
m920205.確か、ペルセナスはかつて、\n荒ぶる亜神、ゴルゴーンを鎮めた逸話があったはず。\:
I recall a legend that Persenas once
quelled the raging sub-deity, Gorgon.
And that shield is probably――
m920205.確かに、王国はいつも綱渡りでしたからね。\nもう慣れっこですよ！: You're right. The Kingdom has always been walking a tightrope. We're used to it!
m920205.神の力でも、神器でもない……。\nいや、魔力の増加すら感じられぬ。\n貴様、その:
It is not the power of a god, nor an artifact…
No, I cannot even detect an increase in mana.
What on earth is that power you possess…!!
m920205.神殿には、資料がない類の存在さ。\n亜神が記した数少ない古書に、\n数行名前が出:
There are no records of them in the temple archives.
They are only mentioned in a few lines
within the rare ancient texts written by the Lesser Gods.
m920205.私に、神獣の力が……。: The power of a divine beast… in me…
m920205.私のことを恨んでいる者も多いでしょうし、\n何もかもが良い方向へ向かうものでもあ:
There are many who hold a grudge against me,
and not everything is heading in a good direction.
m920205.私の力を奪った、と思いましたか？: Did you think you had stolen my power?
m920205.笑っている、のか、余が。\nククッ……そうか、なるほど、これは喜びか。:
Laughing? I am?
Kukku…… I see, I understand. This is joy.
m920205.絶対に、追いついてやる、\n今度は負けないし、負かしてやるんだから！:
I will definitely catch up to you.
I won't lose this time, and I'll beat you!
m920205.綱渡りすぎますけどね……。\n……ふぁぁぁぁ……心臓に悪いですよぉ。:
It was a bit too close for comfort, though…
……Phew… my heart can't take it.
m920205.考えなさい。\n私に賢明なる種族だと思われたいなら――:
Think.
If you wish to be seen as a wise race by me――
m920205.見よ、これこそが真なる神の力。\n創造神を継ぐ、世界最後の神の力である。:
Behold, this is the true power of a god.
The power of the last god in the world, who inherits the Creator.
m920205.見よ、物質界最後の王――いや、王子だったか。\nその目で世界の再誕を見届けるがい: Behold, the last king of the Material World—or was it a prince? Witness the rebirth of the world with your own eyes!
m920205.見習いヨ、近衛隊を見習ッテ、\n立派なゴブリン兵とナルのダゾ！:
Apprentice, learn from the Guard,
and become a proper Goblin soldier!
m920205.観測不能です。\nしかし、先程までの法則改変による異常ではありません。\nこれは:
It is unobservable.

However, it is not an anomaly caused by the recent alteration of laws.

Is it because this is an era with no record in the instruments……?
m920205.言いたいことがあるのは、わかるさ。\n王子には色々と、勝手に背負わせすぎた。:
I know you have something to say.
I've forced too much onto your shoulders, Prince.
m920205.言う必要がないから、ではないでしょうか。: Perhaps it's because there's no need to say it.
m920205.謝る必要ハナイのでアル。\nボロボロにはナッタが、\nその価値はアッタと言えヨウ:
There's no need to apologize.
I may be falling apart,
but it was worth it, I'd say!
m920205.負けたら、その正義に、意味はなくなるのに……。: If I lose, my justice means nothing…….
m920205.近衛隊、セイレツ！！\nメカゴブリンクイーン様の近衛トシテ、\nフサワシイ行進を:
Guard, form up!!
As the personal guard of the Mech Goblin Queen,
we will show a magnificent march!!
m920205.迷っていたのは、お前も同じだろう。\n己が身に与えられし、時の権能に恐れをなし、:
You were lost as well.
You, the Goddess of Time, who feared the authority of time bestowed upon you,
and chose to seal yourself away.
m920205.遥かな過去、伝承にすら残らぬ時代から、\n今までずっと練り上げてきた呪詛の魔術。:
A curse magic I have been refining since a distant past,
from an age left out of even the legends, until now.
Care to have it with your share of my mana?
m920205.遥かな過去、歴史の彼方、\n何者にも語られざる果ての時代……。:
In a distant past, beyond the reach of history,

in an age spoken of by none……
m920205.飛翔……？ きゃっ！？\n地面が揺れて……いえ、本当に飛んでいる！？:
Taking flight…? Kyah!?
The ground is shaking… no, it's really flying!
m920205.驚いたからってぼくに抱きつくな！\nこんなことなら、あの古書、\n偽書だと判断せ:
Don't cling to me just because you're surprised!
If only I hadn't dismissed that old book as a forgery
and read every page...
m920205.魔力の放出量が、あまりに多すぎます。\nこれならば、長時間持続することはないはず:
The amount of magic being released is far too great.
It should not be able to sustain this for long.
――If we survive, an opportunity for a counterattack will present itself.
m920205.魔物によって故郷を失い、それでも抗い続けた者よ。\n余は、お前のような者たちをこ:
You who lost your homeland to monsters,
yet continued to resist.
I thought I wanted to save people like you.
m920205.魔物を引き寄せやすい体質も、\nきっとそれが原因のひとつでしょう。:
Your constitution, which makes you prone to attracting monsters,
is surely one of the results of that.
m920205.（あなたが答えをもたらす、\nそれを手伝ってくれる、そんな聖剣よ）:
(It is a holy sword that you will bring the answer with.
One that will help you do so.)
m920205.（えぇ、おばあちゃん――じゃないわね、\nもっともっと、ずーっと昔の、おばあちゃ:
???: (Yes, my grandmother―no, that's not quite right.
She is a grandmother from much, much, much further back in time.)
m920205.（かつて、太陽の亜神さまは、\n私の一族に、聖なる剣を授けてくれました）:
???: (Long ago, the Sub-Goddess of the Sun
bestowed a holy sword upon my clan.)
m920205.（これからシビラちゃんの記憶をたどって、\n深く潜って、そのきっかけを……鍵を探:
???: (From here, I will trace your memories,
dive deep, and search for the trigger… the key.)
m920205.（これは、答えをもたらす聖剣。\n答えを教えてくれるのでも、\n答えに連れて行っ:
???: (This is a holy sword that brings the answer.
It does not tell you the answer,
nor does it lead you to it―)
m920205.（さぁ、それはどうかしら……？\nシビラちゃんが、\nどんな答えを求めるか次第、:
(Well, I don't know about that……
It depends on what kind of answer
you, Sybilla, seek, I suppose?)
m920205.（そう、これが運命は、\n向こうからやってくるということなのね？）: (So, this is what it means for fate to come to me?)
m920205.（そう！ 気付いていたのね。\nさすが私の血を受け継いだ孫、ひ孫――すごい孫ね！:
???: (That's right! You noticed.
As expected of a descendant who carries my blood, a great-grandchild―what a wonderful descendant!)
m920205.（でも、その時は失敗しちゃった。\nきっと時の女神さまが、\nまだその時じゃない:
???: (But I failed then.
The Goddess of Time must have felt
that the time was not yet right.)

(Hehe, it seems you understood without me having to finish.

m920232.――あ、皆さんおそろいですか？\n簡単にですが、食事の用意ができました。:
――Oh, are you all here together?
I've just finished preparing a simple meal.
I made a portion for Galea too――wait?
Galea?

――Oh, it's the Prince!
And there's a cute little princess with him, too.
m920232.――くだらぬ問答が好みか？\n答えを望むのなら、勝ち取ってみせよ。:
Do you enjoy pointless exchanges?
If you seek an answer, earn it.
m920232.――さぁて、秘密のアジトにとうちゃーく。: ――Well then, welcome to the secret hideout!
m920232.――させませんよ？: Dark Guidance?: —is not what I will allow.
m920232.――さて、それじゃあ事情に詳しそうな二人組に、\nエンキドゥの正体と、\nその目:
W-was I supposed to just keep enjoying the cozy moment?
But, hmm, E-chan's purpose, huh.
m920232.――それは、あなたたちの\n知るべきことではありません。:
That is not something
you should know.
m920232.――なんと。\nこれがこの時代の英雄か。:
—I see.
So this is the hero of this age.
m920232.――ふぅ。\n追いつきましたよ、ラシュマシュ、ズィズィー。:
――Phew.
I've caught up to you, Rashmash, Zizi.
m920232.――やはり強い。\n私が足止めに出てきて正解でした。:
――As expected, he is strong.
It was the right call for me to hold the line.
m920232.――今度こそ、皆を勝利に導くと、約束をしに。: —I go to make a promise. That this time, I will lead them all to victory.
m920232.――北部戦線、トレシア様の領地の\n大要塞群を発ってから二日。: ――Two days since we departed the great fortress cluster in Trescia's territory on the Northern Front.
m920232.――北限の嵐とは、そもそも、\nふたつの領域を隔てるための障壁である。:
――The Northern Storm is, at its core,
a barrier separating two realms.
m920232.――戦いたいのだろう？\nこの身が、ギルガメッシュと呼ばれた者が\n叶えんとする:
――You want to fight, don't you?
This body, the one called Gilgamesh,
will crush the wish you seek to fulfill, right here and now.
m920232.――王子、新手が！\nおそらくエンキドゥの配下……仮面の騎士たちです！:
――Prince, new enemies!
They're probably Enkidu's subordinates…… the Masked Knights!
m920232.――貴様の願いを叶えよう。\n聞こえたか、黒き導きとやら。:
――Very well. I shall grant your wish.
Did you hear that, you so-called "Dark Guidance"?
m920232.…………長きにわたる砦の防衛、大儀であった。: …………Your long vigil in defending this fortress has been honored.
m920232.…………？\nはっ、これより御身を、\nギルガメッシュとお名乗りください。:
…………?
Hah, from now on,
please refer to yourself as Gilgamesh.
m920232.……あやつを思い出すな。\nゆえに、気に入らぬ。:
……He reminds me of someone.
And that is why I dislike him.
m920232.……あァ？ なぜ俺の名を――: ...Huh? Why do you know my name—
m920232.……いずれわたくしもそちらへ行くと。\nその時には、盛大に出迎えるように、とも。:
……When I join them one day,
ask them to give me a grand welcome.
m920232.……えぇ。\nだからこそ、その忠義に報いないとね。:
……Yes.
That's exactly why we must honor their loyalty.
m920232.……けなげなもの、だな。\nよかろう、王であれと望むなら、王となろう。:
……How earnest you are.
Very well. If you wish me to be a king, then I shall be one.
m920232.……これから、色々世話をかけるわね。: ...We'll be putting you through a lot, I suppose.
m920232.……ご招待とあれば、\nその言葉、乗ってあげましょうか。:
……If it's an invitation,
I suppose we might as well accept.
m920232.……そうだね、こんな話をしている場合じゃない。: ……Right, this isn't the time for stories.
m920232.……それだけ聞けばッ！ 十分だッ！！: …That's all we needed to hear! That's enough!!
m920232.……ははっ、なんて魔力だ。\n逸らすだけで手一杯とは。:
……Hah. What magic power.
I'm just barely able to deflect it.
m920232.……ふふっ。\n笑いながら消えていったわ。:
……Heh.
They faded away with a smile.
m920232.……ふん、分かった。\nアンナに頼んで部屋は用意しておくぞ。\nあんまり遅いと僕:
…Hmph, I see.
I'll have Anna prepare a room for you.
But if you're late, I'm turning it into my storage space.
m920232.……ぶちのめすことだけ考えてないか？:
……Are you only thinking about how to beat him?
Finora: As long as Enkidu's purpose remains unclear,
there's a chance we can reach a reconciliation, not just fight.
m920232.……ほう、神の残滓ごときが！\n邪魔立てするか！:
……Hmph. A mere remnant of a god!
Dare you interfere?
m920232.……みんな、泣いてるわ。\n泣きながら、笑ってる。:
……Everyone is crying.
They're crying, but they're smiling.
m920232.……ッ！ ジジジッ、ギギッ、やっ、め――: Dark Guidance?: ...Tch! Jjji, giki, ya, me――
m920232.……何代にも渡って、すこしずつね。: ……It was built up little by little, over many generations.
m920232.……昔の話だ。\nそれから、北部城塞の姫君が、\n俺なんかに様付けする必要はない:
……That's ancient history.
And you, Princess of the Northern Fortress, don't need to use honorifics with me.
m920232.……私が、彼の名誉に\n泥を塗るような真似をするとでも？:
……Would I do something so
beneath his honor?
m920232.……華の国は、見事に復興したはずだが。: ……But the Land of Hua was supposed to have recovered splendidly.
m920232.……記録はなにひとつ。\nただ、心当たりがないことはありません。:
……There is no record of it.
But that doesn't mean I have no idea what it could be.
m920232.……遺跡陣地の方へ向かったようね。: ……It seems they headed toward the ruins camp.
m920232.……遺跡陣地の辺りかしら。: ……It must be around the ruins camp.
m920232.あ、あの、横から失礼します。\nアトナテス様は、やはり北の出身だったのですね。:
Um, excuse me for butting in.
So, Lord Atnates, you really are from the north, aren't you?
m920232.ああ、あいつなら――:
Well then, Prince, Ulyxes,
this is a temporary parting.
m920232.ああ。\nガレア、この時を、ずっと待っていた。:
Yes.
Galea, I have been waiting for this moment.
m920232.あっ、いえいえ。\nちょうど日誌を書き終えたところです。: Ah, no, not at all. I had just finished writing it up.
m920232.あっ、向こうに街が見えてきたよ。\n……街って呼んでいいのか、ちょっと迷うけど。:
Ah, I can see a town over there.
……I'm not sure if it really qualifies as a town, though.
m920232.あっ、教えてくださいのついでに、\nひとつ気になったことが。: Oh, while I have you, there's something I've been wondering about.
m920232.あとは、彼の目覚めを待つのみ。\nその一瞬を、邪魔はさせません。:
Now, all that remains is to wait for his awakening.
I will not allow anyone to interfere with that moment.
m920232.あの戦神は私のこと、嫌いだから。\nズィズィーのことは気に入ってるみたいだけれど:
That war god dislikes me.
Though it seems he takes a liking to you, Zizi.
m920232.あはは……もしそうなったときは\n色々教えてください。: Ahaha…… if that ever happens, please let me know everything you know.
m920232.あやつも素直じゃないのう……。: That one is no more honest than the rest…
m920232.あら、でも必要な助言よ？\n今回だって、意味深に色々教えてあげたし。:
Oh, but isn't that necessary advice?
This time, I gave him plenty of cryptic hints, after all.
m920232.ぃッ……ぅぅぅっ、\nま、魔力の乱れが……視界が、歪んで……っ。:
I... ugh...
The mana is... destabilizing... my vision is... warping...
m920232.いいえ、少なくとも\n自分の教え子ではなさそうです。あなたは？:
No, I don't think
it belongs to any of my students. What about you?
m920232.いい動きだ。\nほんの数秒前の力であれば、\n容易く首を落とされていただろう。:
Good move.
With the power from just a few seconds ago,
your head would have been cut off easily.
m920232.いたっ、痛いっ、本気で痛いっ！\n助けっ、王子、肋がっ、いだっ、痛いからッ！:
Ow! It hurts! Actually hurts!
Help! Prince, my ribs! I— ow, it hurts!
m920232.いや、せめて何を始めるのか説明を――: No, at least explain what you're starting—
m920232.いやいや、年上というのは理不尽なもので――: No, no, being the elder is unreasonable, you know—
m920232.いわふね……ぐるぐるする……。\nきもちわるいー。:
I'm spinning…… everything's going round and round……
I feel so sick.
m920232.うそっ、攻撃魔法！？ 剣士じゃないの！？\n――王子、避けてッ！！:
No way! An attack spell? He's not a swordsman?
—Prince, dodge!!
m920232.うっ、うぅぅぅぅ。\nお主らぁ、ありがとう……ありがとうなのじゃ……。:
Ugh, uuuu…
Thank you all… thank you so much…
m920232.うるさい。\n生きているなら文のひとつでも送らないか！\nこの馬鹿者っ！ 王子が:
Shut up.
If you're alive, send a word!
You idiot! Do you have any idea how much the Prince has grieved?
m920232.うるさい！ 聞こえてるぞ！: Shut up! I can hear you!
m920232.うるせぇ。\n……ただ、そういうのは分かんだよ。:
Shut up.
...I just know how that kind of thing goes.
m920232.うわ、ガールズトークの盗み聞きだ。\nで、ろくなもんじゃねーって？:
Ugh, eavesdropping on a girls' talk.
And what do you mean by "not anything good"?
m920232.うわ、ブチギレキャノンガールも一緒だ。\nこれは楽しめそう……。:
Wow, the raging cannon girl is along too.
This is going to be fun……
m920232.うんうん、成長が感じられるね。\nそれじゃあやっちゃおうラシュマシュ！:
Mm-hm, I can feel your growth.
Now then, let's do this, Rashmash!
m920232.えぇ……今日も、かわいい……。\nわたしの、いもうと……。:
Ehh… you're still so cute….
My… little sister…
m920232.えぇ、きれいな花を咲かせてあげましょう。\n此度は――本気で相手をしてあげるわ。:
Yes, let us bloom a beautiful flower.
This time— I shall take you on, in earnest.
