m920232.えぇ。いつの時代かも知れない、\n遺跡を流用して作られた仮の陣地よ。: Yes. I don't know from what era it dates, but it's a makeshift camp built by repurposing the ruins.
m920232.えぇ。北限の大地に一番詳しいのはあなたよ。\nその知識と経験、見せてちょうだい。:
Yes. You know the Northern Reaches better than anyone.
Show us what that knowledge and experience can do.
m920232.えぇ。貴重な手がかり、ここで捕えるわ。: Yes. We need to catch this valuable clue.
m920232.えぇと……では、越境要塞に戻りましょうか。\n歩ける方は、負傷者に手を貸してくだ:
Um... then let's head back to the Border Fortress.
Those who can walk, please help the wounded!
m920232.えっ、いや……今度、練習してからにしましょう。: W-What? No… let's practice that another time.
m920232.えっ、いや、もうこの前名乗ってもらったので――: W-What? No, you already introduced yourselves last time――
m920232.えっ、味方するってこと？: Huh? You're going to team up with them?
m920232.おぉ、あのホルミースが動揺するなんてね。\nたまには僕らしくないこともしてみるも:
Oh, look at Holmes panicking.
Sometimes it's fun to do something out of character.
m920232.おぉ、おぉ！ 伏綺ちゃん！\n儂が分かるか！？\nお主の妹じゃ、世界一かわいい徐:
Oh, oh! Fuqi-chan!
Can you recognize me?
I'm your little sister, the cutest Xuhua-chan in the world!
m920232.おぉ、来たか。\nちゃんと誅子たちも連れてきたようじゃな。:
Oh, you've come.
It seems you brought Zhuzi and the others, as promised.
m920232.おぉ、武力に訴えてきた。\nいいね、ここがクライマックスかも。:
Oh, she's resorting to force.
Nice. This might be the climax.
m920232.おぉ、美人ガールにいい顔させた。\nラシュマシュやるぅ。:
Ooh, you made the beautiful girl smile.
Nice one, Rashmash.
m920232.お主らを喚んだのは、彼女と縁深き者たちゆえ。: I summoned you because you are deeply connected to her.
m920232.お前も良い腕だ。\nだが、どこまで保つかな！？:
You've got some skill yourself.
But how long can you keep it up?!
m920232.ここからだと、もう少し距離があるわね。: From here, we still have some distance to cover.
m920232.ここで、殺すしかありません。\n際限なく魔力が増幅し続けるなら、\nいずれ大神す:
We have no choice but to kill it here.
If this power keeps amplifying without limit,
it will eventually surpass even the Great God—
m920232.ここに縁は再び結ばれた。\n彼女を――我が姉、伏綺を呼び起こさん。:
Here, our bond is forged anew.
I will call her back—my sister, Fuqi.
m920232.ここは、ロヴィサの一族が、\n多大な犠牲を払いながら、\n人類反撃の一手として開:
This is one of the fortresses that Lovisa's clan developed
at great cost,
as a countermeasure against the humans.
m920232.このまま残った方がいいんじゃないか？\nその方が、お前のやりたいことにも近づくだ:
You, too, Prince. If you don't hold him back soon,
this fool will set off on his travels and
end up starving and rolling around somewhere.
m920232.この強烈な魔力……どうやら嘘じゃねぇみたいだな。\nこんな洞窟に隠れていやがった:
This intense magical power… looks like it's no joke.
Hiding out in a cave like this, huh.
m920232.この誅子、ここ最近は世直しの旅もしているし、\n華の国の民の声にも耳を傾けている:
This Zhuzi has been on a journey to reform the world lately,
and has been listening to the voices of the people of the Land of Hua,
so I thought I was on a fairly serious path……
m920232.この雰囲気は……お説教と見た。: This atmosphere…… I'd say it's a lecture.
m920232.この魔力は、\n神のものでも、人のものでもありません。:
This magic
belongs to neither god nor man.
m920232.こまめな記録は大切だ。\nお嬢さん、書記官をクビになったら、\n研究者の道を志す: Keeping meticulous records is important. If you ever get fired as a secretary, you might consider becoming a researcher.
m920232.これ……氷の柱？\nこんなところで戦ったら割れちゃわない？:
Are these… pillars of ice?
If we fight here, won't they shatter?
m920232.これだけ魔力が絡み合っていれば、\n戦闘時の足場としては十分でしょう。:
With this much power interwoven,
it should be a perfectly stable footing for battle.
m920232.これで肩慣らし、ですか。\nおそろしく戦い慣れていますね。それに――:
So that was the warm-up.
He's incredibly battle-hardened. And besides—
m920232.これは、まいったな、\n大活躍するつもりだったんだけど。:
Well, this is a problem.
I was planning to shine a little.
m920232.ご先祖さまも、きっと感涙しているわ。\n北の大国と王国の合同調査拠点に、\nこの:
Our ancestors must be weeping with joy.
To be chosen as the joint survey base
for the Northern Empire and the Kingdom...
m920232.さぁて、明日には越境要塞に到着するはずよ。\n今日はしっかり身体を休めておいてね:
Well, we should reach the border-crossing fortress by tomorrow.
Get some proper rest tonight.
m920232.さぁゆくぞ、戻ってこい、伏綺ちゃん！！: Now then, let's go! Come back, Fuqi-chan!!
m920232.さすがに、徒歩では間に合わんぞ。: You certainly won't make it in time on foot.
m920232.さっそく出てきやがったか。\n雑魚で時間稼ぎでもしてくるかと思ったぜ。:
You showed up quick, didn't you.
I was hoping you'd send some grunts to waste our time.
m920232.さて、今後の方針ねぇ……。: Now then, regarding our next move…
m920232.さらばだ、当代の英雄よ。\n願いの前に散るが――:
Farewell, hero of this age.
To fall before your wish is granted—
m920232.しかし、分かりやすい。\n戦う気でいるのなら、相手をしてやろう。:
??? : But it's simple enough.
If you're intent on fighting, I'll oblige.
m920232.しかし、時間稼ぎはこれで十分。\nあとは――結晶洞窟の最奥にて、お待ちしています:
However, this should be enough to buy time.
Now then――I await you at the deepest point of the Crystal Cavern.
m920232.したり顔の憎たらしい笑顔だったぜ？: It was a smug, irritating grin, if you ask me.
m920232.じゃああたしの味方であるところの\n超絶美女たるラシュマシュは、\nこの事態をど:
Then, you, Rashmash, the super-beautiful ally of mine,
how do you plan to enjoy this situation?
m920232.ずっと試してはいるのですが、\nまったく感知できない状況ですね。\nおそらく、上:
We've been trying nonstop, but
we're getting absolutely no readings.
It's likely due to the magical storm overhead.
m920232.そいつはいい。\n足場が悪くて暴れられないじゃ困るからな。:
Good.
It would be a pain if I couldn't unleash my full power due to poor footing.
m920232.そう、エっちゃんの方はね、\nお目当ての助っ人――うぅん、\nメインディッシュを:
That's right, as for E-chan,
it seems she's secured her desired reinforcements— hmm,
or rather, her main course.
--- scene: The One Whose Name Was Forgotten (battle, start) ---
m920232.そう、剣技でも魔力でもない何かで、\n私たちは、彼を知っているはず。:
Yes, not through swordsmanship or magic, but through something else,
we should be able to recognize him.
m920232.そう、誰も知らぬはずじゃ。: That's right. No one should know.
m920232.そういう前置きはいらないから。\n王子たちのこと。\n思ったより早く来ちゃったけ:
No need for the preamble.
About the princes.
They got here faster than expected. What's the plan?
m920232.そういえば、この辺りの出身でしたっけ。: Come to think of it, is this where you're from?
m920232.そうそう、どういうつもりなんだろうねー。: Yeah, yeah, what is it up to, I wonder.
m920232.そうだろう？\n王子、と呼ばれていたか。\n貴様からは、力で願いを叶えてきた匂い:
Is that so?
I was once called "Prince."
I can smell the scent of one who has fulfilled wishes through force.
m920232.そうね、彼はきっと、それを望んでいるのよ。: I suppose so. He certainly wishes for that.
m920232.そうねぇ。\nちゃんと王子たちが\n間に合うように手伝ったし、この後は――:
Well, I guess.
I made sure to help the Prince and his party arrive in time, so after this—
m920232.そして彼が、その破滅そのもの、と。: And he himself is that very ruin.
m920232.そして英雄王の後継者、王子。: And the successor to the Hero King, the Prince.
m920232.その呼び名は大変不服ですが……。\nともかく、エンキドゥの居場所を吐いてもらいま:
I strongly object to being called that…
Anyway, I'm going to make you spill Enkidu's location.
m920232.その地を勝ち取り、要塞を築いたからこそ、\n自然と大地が踏み固められ、道ができた: Only by conquering that land and building the fortress did the earth naturally become compacted, forming a road.
m920232.その心配はなさそうです。\nおそらくこの氷は、北限の大地の上空に\n吹き荒れる魔:
I don't think that's a concern.
This ice likely contains the same substance as the magical power
that howls across the skies of the northernmost lands.
m920232.その男は――王子は、ただの人間だろう。\n人は、容易く死ぬものだ。:
That man—the Prince—is merely human, is he not?
Humans are so easily killed.
m920232.その者は、己を大地と同化させ、\n概念となって華の国を癒やし続けた。:
She merged herself with the earth,
becoming a concept, and continued to heal the Land of Hua.
m920232.それじゃあ、今後の方針を決めましょうか。: Then, let's decide on our next move.
m920232.それじゃあ、王子、ユリクセス、\nまた、しばしの別れだ。\n:
Wouldn't it be better if you stayed?
That would bring you closer to what you want to do, wouldn't it?
m920232.それっ、元仲間のセリフかい！？: That's— a line for a former comrade to say!
m920232.それで、なぜ北限の大地に道があるか、だったわね。\nそれは――この先に越境要塞が: So, why is there a road in the Land of the Northern Limit, was it? It's because―― there is a border-crossing fortress ahead.
m920232.それでも、進むしかないわ。\n北部戦線を超えたこの先に、\nエンキドゥたちがいる:
Even so, we have no choice but to press on.
Beyond this northern front,
the Enkidus must be waiting.
m920232.それに、千年も前の話だ。\n北部戦線なんてものが成立するより、ずっと昔のな。\n:
Besides, it was a thousand years ago.
Long before the Northern Front even existed.
I have no idea what could be called home.
m920232.それに、着地点も\nわざわざ幻影で示してくれたりして――:
And it even went out of its way
to show us the landing point with an illusion—
m920232.それに、黒き導きと思しき存在のことも気になるね。\n敵対したり味方になったり、\:
And that entity we believe to be the Dark Guidance is concerning, too.
It switches between enemy and ally—
what on earth is it trying to do...?
m920232.それゆえに、触れるべきではない力に、\nその手を伸ばしたのだろう。:
And so, you reached out
for a power that should not be touched.
m920232.それより、また魔物の群れが来たぜ。\nどうする、やり過ごすか？:
More importantly, another horde of monsters is coming.
What do we do, evade them?
m920232.それを取り戻すために、\nあれこれ画策してたってくらいかなー、知ってるのは。: To retrieve what was once abandoned…
m920232.そんな身体でよく言う。\n戦う前から負傷者だっただろ。:
With that body of yours?
You were a casualty before the battle even started.
m920232.だが、貴様が願い続ける限り、\nこの身に眠る魂が消えることはない。:
But as long as you continue to wish,
the soul sleeping within this body will not vanish.
m920232.ちょうどその道を築いた方と合流したので、\n紹介もかねて説明してしまいましょう。: I've just met up with the person who built that road, so let me explain while I introduce her. ――Lovisa, come here. Please, have a seat.
m920232.っはぁ、はぁ、ぐぅぅっ……。\nあいつ、黒冠の力を、無理やり引き出してます……！:
Haa... haa... ugh...
He's... forcing the power of the Black Crown out...
m920232.では、エンキドゥという名は？\nこれだけ仰々しい名前だもの、\nおそらく本名では:
Enkidu… the name of a retainer who supported an ancient king.
He is said to have been a close friend, a brother,
or even a father or son to the king.
m920232.でも、様子が変ね……。\n魔物の軍勢に攻め落とされたはずなのに、\n砦の中が、や:
But something feels off…….
It should have been overrun by the monster army,
and yet the fortress is suspiciously quiet……
m920232.どう、フローガ。\n魔力の乱れは近付いてる？:
Well, Floga.
Is the magical disturbance getting closer?
m920232.どうか、あなたがこの世界を率いてください。\nすべての失敗を、後悔を、\nなにも:
Please, lead this world.
Erase every failure, every regret,
erase everything, and create the ideal world!
m920232.どうかしら？\nここなら北限の大地の調査拠点にうってつけでしょう？:
How is it?
This would be perfect as a base for surveying the Northern Limit, wouldn't it?
m920232.どうしても言わないというのなら――えっ。: If you absolutely refuse to say— Huh?
m920232.どうもどうも。\nあらあら、かわいいお嬢様たちね。\nわたくしも交ぜてもらってい: How do you do. Oh my, what lovely young ladies. May I join you?
m920232.どっちの味方か分からないのは、\nきみたちも似たりよったりだと思うけど。\nで、:
It's hard to tell who's on our side, but
I think you two are just as unpredictable.
So, if you're willing to help, will you come with us?
m920232.どんな物語もね、歴史の転換点、\nその瞬間にすべてが変わるという瞬間が、一番楽し:
In every story, the turning point of history,
that moment when everything changes, is the most exciting part.
m920232.なぁに？ 何か悩みごと？: Hm? Are you troubled by something?
m920232.ならば、それだけ人が強くなればいい。\n王子の手が届かぬ場所で誰かが嘆くなら、\:
Then let people grow strong enough to stand on their own.
If someone is suffering beyond the Prince's reach,
there should be a fool kind enough to rush to their aid.
m920232.ならば、それに相応しい力が必要だろう。\nさぁ、力を貸せ、神が残滓たる力よ。:
If so, you will need power worthy of that.
Come forth, lend me your strength, you remnants of the gods.
--- scene: Two Heroes ---
m920232.ねーぇー、ラシュマシュ。\nノリと勢いで色々しちゃってるけどさ、\nこの後どうす:
Hey, Rashmash.
We've been running on pure momentum and doing all sorts of things,
but what are you planning to do next?
m920232.はぁ、いつまで経っても素直じゃないですねぇ。: Haa, you're still as stubborn as ever.
m920232.はい、再会を喜ぶのはそこまで。\n一旦越境要塞に戻らないと。:
Alright, that's enough rejoicing.
We need to return to the Border Fortress for now.
m920232.はいはい、かわいいズィズィーの味方でもあるわ。: Yes, yes, I am also on the side of my darling Zizi.
m920232.はっ……。\nいえ、ここはまだ北部城塞から近い場所ですから、\n可能な限り殲滅し:
Hmph……
No, we're still close to the Northern Fortress, so
we'll wipe them out as much as we can.
m920232.はっ。越境調査部隊を中心に部隊再編成！\n目的地は結晶洞窟最奥。\n北限の誇り、:
Aye! Reorganize the unit around the Border Patrol!
Destination: the depths of the Crystal Cavern.
Show them the pride of the North, now!
m920232.ははっ、さすがユリクセス、\n僕の調子を一発で見抜くとは。:
Haha! As expected of Ulyxes.
You saw right through me in an instant.
m920232.ははは……王子にはバレているみたいだ。: Hahaha… It seems the Prince has seen through me.
m920232.ふぅ……。\nやっぱり、黒冠の魔物が増えているみたいね。:
Phew……
It really does seem like the number of Black Crown monsters is increasing.
m920232.ふぅ……今日の行軍日誌はおしまい、っと。: Phew…… that's it for today's march log.
m920232.まぁ、そうですけど……。\n――こほん。こちらはロヴィサ。\n私と同じく、北部戦: Well, I suppose you're right…… ――Ahem. This is Lovisa. Like me, she is the head of a noble house that shoulders the burden of the Northern Front.
m920232.まぁ、僕ではまだ力が足りないだろうけどね。: Though I suppose I'm still not strong enough for that, myself.
m920232.まぁ、先に思いっきり戦闘になるって\n教えてほしかったけどね。: Well, I wish you'd have warned us it would turn into a full-on fight first.
m920232.まぁ、陥落してしまったのだけれどね。: Well, it has since fallen, though.
m920232.まぁ否定はせんが。\n――さて、では始めるとしようか。:
I won't deny it.
—Well then, let us begin.
m920232.まずは肩慣らしだ。\n――来い、見知らぬ戦士たちよ。:
??? : Let's start with a warm-up.
—Come forth, unknown warriors.
m920232.またエっちゃんの手伝いでもする？\nそれかマレスのところにでも遊びに行く？:
Are you going to help E-chan again?
Or maybe go visit Maless?
m920232.また会おう、王子よ。\n北の果てにて――貴様を――:
Until we meet again, Prince.
At the edge of the north— you—
m920232.まだもう少し遠く、ですね。\nどれくらいの距離かは判断できません。:
It's still a bit further off.
I can't tell exactly how far.
m920232.みんな、戦闘準備を。\n戦士の霊魂を眠らせてあげましょう。:
Everyone, prepare for battle.
Let's put the warrior spirits to rest.
m920232.むっ……あいつは、\nフィノーラ様を一度手にかけているんですよ？\n無かったこと:
Right now, I'm alive and well.
In some cases, even personal grudges can be set aside.
m920232.もう、お茶会じゃないんですから……。: Oh, it's not a tea party, you know……
m920232.もうひとりのメインディッシュは\nお気に入りを手に入れてご満悦みたいだし、\n叙:
The other main course seems quite pleased
with having secured his favorite, so
perhaps we need to step up our game for the sake of the epic?
m920232.もとより私たちは、誰の味方でもないもの。\nさぁ、ついていらっしゃい。:
We have never been on anyone's side, after all.
Now then, come with us.
m920232.やられるときの練習してないし……。: I haven't practiced how to lose, after all……
m920232.やれやれ、謀略の亜神も型なしじゃなぁ♪: Well, well, even a sub-god of scheming has no type, does he? ♪
m920232.やーなおーんなー。でもいいおんなー。\nん……あれ？ じゃあなんで、\n案内した:
You're such a woman. But a good one.
Hm... wait. Then why are you still following the Prince and his party
even after guiding them?
m920232.よし、独り占めはよくないし――\nラシュマシュー！ おーい！\n王子たちが遊ばれ:
Alright, I can't hog all the fun for myself――
Rashmashu! Hey!
The Princes are coming to play!
m920232.りょーかい。\nじゃ、ちょっと名乗るから見ててよ。:
Got it.
I'm going to introduce myself, so watch this.
m920232.ろくなもんじゃねぇと思うけどな。: I doubt it'll be anything good.
m920232.わ、そのままイチャイチャ空間続けるのかと思った。\nでも、うーん、エっちゃんの目:
Should we tell you?
Though, we don't know all the details ourselves.
m920232.わっ、王子は気付いたみたいだ。: Wow, the Prince seems to have noticed.
m920232.わわっ、座ったままで大丈夫ですよ。\nそれで、なぜ道があるのかでしたね。: W-Won't you sit down? No need to stand. So, why is there a road, was it?
m920232.ん、そういえば……。\nイコルは何のためにここへ？:
Hm, come to think of it….
What are you doing here, Ikol?
m920232.んー……。\n何か過去にさ、大切なものを諦めたらしいんだよね。:
That's all we know, really.
He's been scheming to get it back.
m920232.アタシたちのことも、敵だと認識したみたい。: They seem to recognize us as the enemy, too.
m920232.アトナテス、これは戦士にしか感じ取れないものです。\n見知らぬ剣技、見知らぬ体術:
Atnates, this is something only warriors can sense.
Unknown swordsmanship, unknown martial arts,
yet if their breathing syncs with ours—
m920232.エっちゃんの所行くんでしょ？\nんー、んんー、どうしようかな。:
You're heading to E-chan's place, right?
Hmm, hmm, what should I do……
m920232.エンキドゥ……古の王を支えた家臣の名だ。\n親友であったとも、兄弟であったとも、:
A tale from the desert lands, I suppose.
Since he uses it as an alias,
I suspect there's some hidden meaning behind it.
m920232.エンキドゥ、仮面の騎士たちの気配も消えています。: Enkidu and the masked knights are gone, too.
m920232.エンキドゥの目的が不明である以上、\n戦う可能性だけでなく、和解できる可能性もあ:
Mmph… that guy
once had his hands on Her Finora, didn't he?
Even if it's considered a thing of the past, shaking hands with him…
m920232.ガキの頃のことなんて、\nほとんど覚えてねぇけどな。: I barely remember anything from when I was a kid.
m920232.ガレア……マレス様……？\nどうして……ゆ、ゆゆ、幽霊ですか！？:
Galea… Mares-sama…?
Why… y-you, you're a ghost?!
m920232.ギルガメッシュ……。\nそれが、この肉体の名か。:
Gilgamesh…
Is that the name of this body?
m920232.ギルガメッシュ、我が王、\nずっと目覚めの時を待ちわびておりました。:
Gilgamesh, my king,
I have waited so long for the moment of your awakening.
m920232.ギルガメッシュは、北の果てと言っていたね。\nロヴィサ、何か心当たりはあるかい？:
Gilgamesh mentioned the edge of the north.
Lovisa, does that ring any bells?
m920232.シビラ殿下、先陣は任せてもらっても？: Your Highness Sybilla, may I take the vanguard?
m920232.ズィズィー、わざとらしいわ？: Zizi, that was a bit much, wasn't it?
m920232.トレシア、あまり持ち上げないで。\n父の代で陥落してしまったって、\n言い出しに:
Trescia, please stop praising it.
It makes it harder to bring up
that it fell during my father's time.
m920232.ドーンブリンガーの観測装置が使えない以上、\nエンキドゥたちの足取りは、\n地道:
Since the Dawnbringers' observation equipment is useless,
it looks like we'll have to track the Enkidus' movements
the hard way.
m920232.フフッ、ハハッ、ハーッハッハッハッハ！\nそうか、貴様らしい馬鹿な選択だ。:
Fufu, haha, ha ha ha ha ha!
I see. A foolish choice, just like you.
m920232.フローガちゃん！ 目を閉じて！\nこんな魔力の暴走、\nあなたの目が焼ききれちゃ:
Floga! Close your eyes!
A mana surge like this...
will scorch your eyes right out!
m920232.メインディッシュが\n先に来たくらいで慌てちゃだめよ？:
We can't panic just because the main course
arrived a little early, can we?
m920232.ユリクセス、やり過ぎだよ。\n――僕が蹴る分も残しておいて。:
Ulyxes, that was going too far.
—Leave some room for my kicks, too.
m920232.ロヴィサのことを、先代の後継者だって理解したみたい。\nおかえりなさいって言って:
It seems they understand that Lovisa is the successor to their former lord.
They're saying, "Welcome home."
m920232.上空に待機させてはいますが、\n地上の様子が一切観測できない状況です。:
We're holding position in the air, but
we can't observe anything on the ground.
m920232.上等だ。\n向こうから、正解に近付いてるって\n知らせてくれたようなものだぜ。:
Excellent.
They're practically telling us they've found the right path.
m920232.不敬な。\n歴史の終焉たるこの時代のあなたたちが、\n彼を知っているはずがないで:
How insolent.
You, who live in this era that marks the end of history,
could never possibly know him.
m920232.人の住めない地だと聞いていましたが……。\nこれほどの要塞を築いていたとは。:
I heard this was uninhabitable……
I had no idea a fortress of this scale existed here.
m920232.人はいずれ、貴様を怖れるぞ。\n歴史がそれを証明している。:
People will eventually fear you.
History proves it.
m920232.人聞きが悪いなぁ。\nロマンのバランスを取ってるだけだよ。:
That's a harsh way to put it.
We're just keeping the balance of romance.
m920232.今の貴様は、折れた剣に等しい。\nそのひび割れた刀身で、何を果たさんとする？:
As you are now, you are no different from a broken sword.
What do you hope to accomplish with that cracked blade?
m920232.今はこうして無事に生きているんだ。\n場合によっては、個人的な恨みだって隠せるも:
It's not a very pleasant thought,
having someone dear to you accept your death…
m920232.今度は、勝ってみせるさ。: This time, I'll show you a victory.
m920232.今度は、間に合ったかい？: Did you make it in time this time?
m920232.今後の課題ね。: A topic for future study, then.
m920232.修行が足りんぞガレア。\n王子ならば、ここで魔法を打ち返すところだ。:
You need more training, Galea.
The Prince would have returned the spell right here.
m920232.俺様が名を授けてやった頃の、\n理想を愚直に追い求める、戦士の顔だ。:
It's the face of a warrior who blindly pursues his ideals,
just as you were when I bestowed your name.
m920232.傷も癒えていない身で、どこへ行くつもりだ。: Where do you intend to go with your wounds still unhealed?
m920232.僕を英雄と呼んでくれた、かつての仲間に、\n僕をまた迎えてくれた、新たな仲間に―:
To the old friends who once called me a hero,
and the new friends who welcomed me back—
m920232.儂に借りがあるからと、伏綺ちゃんの復活計画を、\nあれこれずーっと考えてくれてお:
Just because I owed him, he spent so much time
thinking up all sorts of plans for Fuqi-chan's revival.
m920232.儂のこと、なんだと思っとるんじゃ……。: What do you think I am, exactly……
m920232.光神の槍に、人間の戦士に、\n魔竜の騎士か……良い腕だが、それだけに残念だ。:
The Spear of the Light God, human warriors,
and the Knight of the Demon Dragon… You have impressive skills,
which makes this all the more regrettable.
m920232.入り組んだ海流の向こう、過酷な渓谷を超えた先、\nそういったたどり着けない場所に:
Beyond the tangled currents and the harsh canyons,
in places no one can reach,
people of old must have yearned to go. That's the prevailing theory, anyway.
m920232.再興を。\n価値なき世界に、新たなる再興を。\nあなたのいない世界に、価値はあり:
Restoration.
A new restoration for this worthless world.
A world without you has no value.
m920232.冗談言ってる場合じゃねぇだろ！\n王子、ヤツをブチのめして押し通るぞ！:
This isn't the time for jokes!
Prince, let's beat that guy down and push through!
m920232.出会いと別れは一期一会。\nふたりのロマンはこの場限り。\nならば血の花咲かせよ:
Every meeting is a farewell.
Our romance ends here.
So let us bloom a flower of blood, upon your beloved chest!
m920232.出会いは別れの始まりなれば、\n流るる一瞬さえも愛おしい。\nならば咲かせよう裏:
If meeting is the start of parting,
then even a fleeting moment is precious.
So let us bloom the flower of betrayal, in this lyric poem.
m920232.北の大国では有名な神話、\nいいや、おとぎ話ってところだね。:
It's a famous myth in the Northern Empire.
Or rather, a fairy tale.
m920232.北の大国の民を守るために、\n数多の血を流しながら、\n北限の大地の調査をし続け: It is the crystallized result of countless sacrifices, made to protect the people of the Northern Great Power while we continued to survey the Land of the Northern Limit.
m920232.北の貴族は、戦場でお茶会ができて一人前よ？\n常に魔物の脅威を抑え込む、\n北部: Among the northern nobility, being able to hold a tea party on the battlefield is a rite of passage. Especially for us, who bear the weight of the Northern Front and constantly hold back the monster threat.
m920232.北部戦線のさらに北――\n「北限の大地」と呼ばれているこの地域ですが、\nなぜ道: Further north than the Northern Front―― in this region known as the "Land of the Northern Limit," why is there a road?
m920232.千年戦争の折、華の国の大地は酷く傷ついた。\nその大地はおよそ、幾万年は不毛の地:
During the Millennium War, the land of the Land of Hua was grievously wounded.
That land was left barren for tens of thousands of years.
m920232.吹雪いてきそうですね。\nはぐれないように注意してください。:
A blizzard looks like it's coming.
Be careful not to get separated.
m920232.吹雪を抜けたようですね……。: It looks like we've made it through the blizzard……
m920232.周囲を警戒しつつ進みましょう。\nおそらく、吹雪に乗じて魔物が襲ってくるはずです:
Let's proceed while keeping watch.
The monsters will likely strike while we're caught in the blizzard.
m920232.命までは取らないわ。\nエンキドゥの居場所を教えてもらえる？:
I won't take your lives.
Will you tell me where Enkidu is?
m920232.変な顔とは失礼な。\nミステリアスな微笑みと言ってください。: How rude. Please call it a mysterious smile.
m920232.大丈夫？\n上着、一枚貸そうか？:
Are you okay?
Want to borrow one of my coats?
m920232.大切な人が、自分の死を受け入れるのは、\nあんまりいい気分じゃないです……。:
Don't worry, Avric.
I'm not saying we should take any lives lightly.
What matters is figuring out what Enkidu is after.
m920232.天界の門から、ここまで一直線に。\nマレス様の加護はすごいね。\nこんな魔力を帯:
In a straight line from the Gates of the Heavens.
Mares-sama's protection is amazing.
It can even shatter ice charged with this much magic.
m920232.奇妙な魔力の反応が、ふたつ。\nここからさらに北に進んだ辺りで、\nふらふらと彷:
There are two strange magical reactions.
Further north from here,
they seem to be wandering aimlessly.
m920232.姉妹の再会か……。\n千年ぶりとは、涙もひとしおだろうなぁ。:
A reunion between sisters….
After a thousand years, the tears must be all the more bitter.
m920232.姫殿下、お気になさらないでくださいな。\n彼らは北の大国に殉じた戦士たち。\n民:
Princess, please don't be troubled.
They were warriors who gave their lives for the Northern Kingdom.
Dying to protect the people must have been their greatest wish.
m920232.嫌いなんじゃなくて、苦手なんだと思うけど……。\nいつも意味深なことだけ言い残し:
I don't think he dislikes you, I think he's just... bad with people.
He always leaves behind cryptic remarks, you know.
m920232.少しは、昔の顔つきに戻ってきたではないか。: You've at least regained a bit of your old look.
m920232.強く、理想に燃え、なお貪欲に願いを追い続ける。\n素晴らしい、実に輝きに満ちてい:
Strong, burning with ideals, yet still greedily chasing his desires.
Magnificent. Truly radiant.
m920232.彼の再誕を、その目に焼き付けるがいいでしょう。: Witness his rebirth with your own eyes.
m920232.徐華に借りを返しただけだよ。\nそれじゃあ、ぼくは用事があるから。:
I was just repaying a debt to Xuhua.
Anyway, I have things to do.
m920232.心配しなくても、すぐに戻るよ。\nただ、その前になすべきことがあってね。:
Don't worry, I'll be back soon.
I just have some business to take care of first.
m920232.心配するな、アヴリック。\n何も命を粗末にしようって話じゃないからね。\n重要な:
――Now then, let's ask the pair who seem to know
the details about Enkidu's true identity
and his objectives.
m920232.思いっきり高度をあげてついていくか、\n思いっきり高度を下げて、\n地表ギリギリ:
Looks like we either have to climb to maximum altitude to follow them,
or drop to the bare minimum and hug the ground.
m920232.愚問だな。\nエンキドゥよ、貴様の知るこの者であれば、\n決してこのような再誕は:
A foolish question.
Enkidu, if this were the man you knew,
he would never have desired such a rebirth.
m920232.我が臣下、エンキドゥよ。\n貴様はこの世界に、何を望む。:
My subject, Enkidu.
What do you desire from this world?
m920232.戦場のど真ん中にぼくを投擲した、\n勢いで生きている徐華娘々、\nといったところ:
The young lady Xuhua, who threw me into the heart of the battlefield,
and lives by sheer momentum, if I had to guess?
m920232.教えてあげたら？\nと言っても、私たちも詳しいわけではないけれど。:
Hmm…
Apparently, in the past, he gave up on something precious.
m920232.昔のアトナテスみたいですね？: That sounds just like the old Atnates, doesn't it?
m920232.時間稼ぎをするのなら、\n彼の騎士たる私が、自分の手でするべきでしょう。:
If I'm going to buy time,
it should be I, his knight, who does it with my own hands.
m920232.望むところです、姫殿下。\n何しろこの先の世界を知るために、\n当家はここまで戦:
It is our honor, Your Highness.
After all, our house has fought this far
to learn of the world beyond.
m920232.正義が武力を振りかざすなら、\n悪は華麗に名乗ってあげないとね。:
If justice wields its might,
then evil must introduce itself with grace.
m920232.決まっているわ。\nロマンのあるやり方で、\nちゃんと敵役を務めてあげなくちゃ。:
It's obvious.
I must play the villain properly,
in a romantic fashion.
m920232.然り。では何者が、\n大地の傷を癒やし続けたのか。:
Indeed. So tell me, who
continued to heal the wounds of the earth?
m920232.王国、北の大国の合同遠征部隊は、\nまっすぐに北の雪原を北上中。: The joint expeditionary force of the Kingdom and the Northern Great Power is marching straight north across the snowy plains.
m920232.王国式の、それもとても古い剣技……。\nクレイブ、心当たりは？:
A royal style of swordsmanship… and a very old one at that.
Crave, does that ring any bells?
m920232.王子、上空からの調査結果はどう？\nドーンブリンガーを飛ばしているんでしょう？:
Prince, what did the aerial survey turn up?
You've got the Dawnbringers out there, right?
m920232.王子、急ぎ拠点を使えるようにしましょう。\nここから先の調査は、さらに過酷になる:
Prince, let's get the base operational as soon as possible.
The investigation ahead will only get more grueling.
m920232.王子の味方もしない、エっちゃんの味方もしない。\nそれなら、今ラシュマシュは何を:
You're not on the Prince's side, and you're not on E-chan's side.
So what exactly are you trying to do right now, Rashmash?
m920232.王子よ、お主こそが最後の鍵じゃ。\n概念として荒ぶる伏綺を鎮め、\n現世に再び、:
Prince, you are the final key.
Calms the raging concept that is Fuqi,
and bring my sister back to the world of the living.
m920232.王子よ、手は貸さんぞ。\n――こいつを届けただけで、貴様には十分だろう。:
Prince, I will not lend you my hand.
—Having delivered this, that should be enough for you.
m920232.王子殿下、シビラ殿下、魔物の群れが来ます！\n総員、周辺警戒を！ 戦闘に入ります:
Your Highness, Sybilla-sama, a horde of monsters is approaching!
All units, secure the perimeter! We're engaging!
m920232.知らない戦い方だってのに、反応できる。\nさっきのエンキドゥもそうだ。\nソラス:
He can react to fighting styles he's never seen before.
That Enkidu from earlier was the same.
Solais, what on earth are these people!
m920232.知る必要はない、と言ったでしょう。: I told you, you don't need to know.
m920232.砦に残された戦士の霊魂たちが、\n魔物を追い払ったのね。\nでも彼らも長い年月に:
The spirits of the warriors who remained in the fortress
drove the monsters away.
But after so many years, their memories have worn thin――
m920232.神々を殺した者の、魔力の響き方だ。: It is the resonance of magic from one who has slain gods.
m920232.神でもなく、人でもなく、仙人でもなく、\n大地そのものとなった彼女の名は、\nす:
Not a god, not a human, not an immortal—
she became the very earth itself.
Her name was erased from the memories of all.
m920232.神の試練を乗り越えたのだろう。\nだが、何故未だ人の身に収まっている。:
You must have overcome the trials of the gods.
Yet why do you still remain within a mortal frame?
m920232.私に聞かないでください！\n魔力だけ見れば、未知の存在に間違いないんです！:
Please don't ask me!
Judging by their magic power alone, they must be something unknown!
m920232.私は私だけの味方よ？: I am only on my own side.
m920232.立ち会いたいじゃない？\nエンキドゥがなりふり構わずに求めた、\nどうしても取り:
I simply want to witness it.
The rebirth of the thing Enkidu sought without regard for consequences,
the thing he desperately wanted to reclaim.
m920232.答えを知りたくば、剣をとれ。\nこの戦いを生き延びられたなら、自ずと理解できよう:
If you wish to know the answer, take up your sword.
If you survive this battle, understanding will come naturally.
m920232.終わりよければ、だ。\nそれにしても、華の国が最大の恩人を、\nまさか国の民すべ:
If the ending is good, that's what matters.
Still, to think the Land of Hua forgot its greatest benefactor…
that the entire populace forgot her…
m920232.自分が目指すものを、他の何かに\n重ねてしまったなら、その先に待つのは破滅のみ。:
If you mistake what you truly seek for something else,
all that awaits you is ruin.
m920232.自分だけの大切なものを、\nおとぎ話なんかと重ねて気持ちよくなってやがる。\n自:
He takes something precious only to himself and projects it onto some fairy tale to feel better.
The end of a man drunk on his own delusions is always the same.
m920232.至近距離、かつ膨大な魔力を持つ存在だからこそ、\nぎりぎり魔力の乱れを感知できた:
Only because they are so close and possess such immense power
could we barely detect the magical disturbance.
m920232.興味はあるが、ここで摘み取っておくべきか。: I am curious, but perhaps I should cut this short.
m920232.若い祈りだ……。\nしかし、実に微笑ましい。:
A young man's prayer...
How truly adorable.
m920232.英雄がふたり、か。\n見せてみよ、この時代の英雄の力を！:
Two heroes, huh.
Show me the power of the heroes of this age!
m920232.華の国が強者、ロウユ、ジンレイ。: The strong ones of the Land of Hua, Rouyu and Jinrei.
m920232.華の国が王、誅子。: The King of the Land of Hua, Zhuzi.
m920232.行ってくるがよい。\nそして今度こそ、理想を掴んでみせよ！:
Go, then.
And this time, seize your ideals!
m920232.裏切る、ということですか？: To betray…… is that what you mean?
m920232.覚悟はできている、か。\nならば、ここに散るがいい。:
So you are prepared.
Then perish here.
m920232.親子、だと……？\nてめぇの親父の蘇生でも願ったのか、エンキドゥ。:
Father and son, you say...?
Did you wish for your own father's resurrection, Enkidu?
m920232.調査拠点として申し分ない設備よ。\nありがとう、ロヴィサ。:
It's a perfect setup for a research base.
Thank you, Lovisa.
m920232.諦めたものを、取り戻しに……。:
Then, what about the name Enkidu?
Such a grandiose title…
It's likely not his real name, is it?
m920232.貴様の願い、この身が戦い続けることで叶えてやろう。\n戦い続ける限り、この肉体は:
I will grant your wish by continuing to fight.
As long as I keep fighting, this body shall be immortal.
――My child, Enkidu, your wish is fulfilled here.
m920232.貴様は、強くなりすぎた。\n神の庇護なき世界で、それだけの力を持って何を望む。:
You have grown too strong.
In a world without the gods' protection, what do you desire with such power?
m920232.貴様らの弱点は、よく分かった。\nその男を失えば容易く瓦解する、\n脆く、弱い戦:
I have seen your weakness clearly.
Lose that man, and you will collapse in an instant.
You are nothing but fragile, weak soldiers.
m920232.貴様を呼ぶ声はない。\n貴様を求める戦場もない。:
No one is calling for you.
There is no battlefield that seeks you.
m920232.貴重な手がかりになりそうね。\n王子、方針はあのふたりを探す、でいいかしら？:
That seems like a valuable lead.
Prince, shall we make finding the two of them our priority?
m920232.越境要塞の書庫には、古い地図があります。\nそこに記されているのは、\n有史以前:
The library at the Border Fortress holds an old map.
It depicts lands from before recorded history,
unknown territories spoken of only in myth.
m920232.越境要塞の確保ができて助かりましたね。\nここに物資を運び込んで、\n北限の大地:
I'm glad we were able to secure the border fortress.
Let's transport supplies here and
use it as a base for surveying the Northern Lands.
m920232.越境要塞は再び、北の大国の手中に戻った。\n戦士たちよ、安らかに眠り給え。:
The Border Fortress has returned to the hands of the Northern Kingdom.
Rest in peace, warriors.
m920232.越境要塞を建てる前の、仮の拠点だった場所ですもの。\nすでに吹雪と魔物に破壊され:
It was a temporary base before the border fortress was built.
It should already be destroyed by the blizzard and the monsters.
m920232.過酷な気候、野生の獣に、無数の魔物。\nそういった脅威から、北の大国の民を守るた:
Harsh climates, wild beasts, and countless monsters.
They built it to protect the people of the Northern Kingdom from such threats.
m920232.遠慮しておくわ。\nガレア君の活躍も見られたし、\nマレスに貸しも作れたし、今回:
I'll pass this time.
I've had my fun watching Galea shine,
and I've settled my debt with Mares. I'm perfectly satisfied.
m920232.長い夢から覚めてみれば、\nどうにも、騒がしいものだな。:
??? : Waking from such a long dream,
I find the world rather noisy.
m920232.長らく王国の兵たちを見てきましたが……。\nこんな剣筋の者は見たことがありません:
I've watched the kingdom's soldiers for a long time…
I've never seen swordwork like that before.
m920232.集落どころか、盗賊の隠れ家すらもなし。\n数多の伝承に語られる北の大地は、\nや: No settlements, not even a bandit's hideout. The northern lands, as countless legends describe, truly are the domain of monsters.
m920232.霊魂たちが消えていくけれど、\n何か最後に、伝えておくことはある？:
The spirits are fading away, but
is there anything you'd like to say to them before they go?
m920232.騎竜を従えているのを見て、\nもしやと思っていたのですが……。:
Seeing you command a dragon rider,
I had my suspicions, but……
m920232.魔力の嵐と氷に閉ざされた、\n人類の生存を認めぬ極寒の大地。\n魔物たちの領域、:
A land of bitter cold, sealed off by a storm of magic and ice,
where human life is not permitted.
The domain of the monsters, the Northern Snowfields……
m920232.魔力の嵐に阻まれており、\n北限全域に渡って、光学的にも、\n魔力的にもジャミン:
A storm of magical energy is blocking us.
It's like the entire Northern Limit is under jamming,
both optically and magically.
m920232.魔力の探知は？\nエンキドゥが何かを企んでいるのなら、\n魔力の乱れを感知できな:
What about magic detection?
If the Enkidus are up to something,
can't we sense the disturbance in the magic?
m920232.魔物がいないのも、納得。\nここはもう奪還されているんだから。:
It makes sense that there are no monsters here.
This place has already been reclaimed.
m920232.黒冠の、根源の魔力が流れ込んでますよぅ……。\nこんな膨大な魔力、\n人間の身体:
The primordial power of the Black Crown is flowing into it…
There's no way a human body could withstand
such an immense amount of magic!
m920232.（――僕は、深淵を追う者だ）: (—I am the one who chases the Abyss.)
m920232.（――深淵を知る者、か。\n大層な二つ名もあったものだ）:
(—The One Who Knows the Abyss.
Quite a grand title, isn't it?)
m920232.（……怖い女だ。\nトレシアも相当だが、ロヴィサもまた、\n戦場を渡り歩いてきた:
(……She's a frightening woman.
Trescia is intense, too, but Lovisa has the look of someone who
has walked through countless battlefields)
m920232.（あいつに感じた、違和感。\n王国式剣技を使う、見知らぬ男）:
(That sense of unease I felt around him.
A stranger wielding the Kingdom's sword techniques.)
m920232.（そうだな、お前が深淵を知ると嘯くなら――）: (Indeed. If you claim to know the Abyss—)
m920232.（だが、俺はあいつを知っている……？\n顔も魔力も戦い方も、なにひとつ知らないは:
(But I know him…?
I shouldn't know his face, his magic, or his fighting style at all.)
m920232.（だが、知っているか、アトナテス。\n本当に大切なものは、目を離せばすぐに消えて:
(But you know, Atnates.
Truly precious things vanish the moment you look away.)
m920232.（ちっ、知ったことかよ。\nエンキドゥ、てめぇが立ちはだかるなら――）:
(Tch, who cares.
Enkidu, if you're going to stand in my way—)
m920232.（知っている顔じゃねぇ。\n魔力の匂いも、俺の知る誰とも似ていない）:
(I don't recognize that face.
His magical aura doesn't resemble anyone I know, either.)
m920232.（越境要塞、か。\n覚悟して向かった方がよさそうだ）:
(The border-crossing fortress, huh.
I suppose it's best to go in prepared for the worst)

m940010.――うむ。\n帝国軍との戦いであれば望むところ。\n偽りの皇帝よ！ その首、ここ:
――Indeed.
A battle against the Imperial Army is exactly what I want.
False Emperor! I shall take your head here and now!!
m940010.――おつかれさまでーす。\nオルドネッタ、物資の補給に参りました！:
――Thanks for your hard work!
Ordonetta here, come to resupply you with provisions!
m940010.――さぁ、白の皇帝よ！\n帝国法にのっとり、ここに決闘を申し込む！:
――Now then, White Emperor!
In accordance with Imperial law, I challenge you to a duel!
m940010.――イルヴィ族長、そちらから、\n白の帝国に望むことはあるか？:
――Clan Leader Irvit, does your side have any requests
of the White Empire?
m940010.――俺の寿命は、残り数年らしいな。: —It seems I have only a few years left to live.
m940010.――双方、代表者は揃いましたか？: ――Are the representatives from both sides present?
m940010.――帝国を敵に回すという、その意味を、\nタルタロスに潜む者たちに教えてやろう。:
—I will teach those lurking in Tartarus
the true meaning of making the Empire their enemy.
m940010.――帝国領内、オーク居留地にて: ――Within the Imperial territory, at the Orc Settlement
m940010.――数日後、帝国領内ダークエルフ居留地にて: ――A few days later, at the Dark Elf settlement within Imperial territory
m940010.――新たなオークロードよ。\n白の帝国に望むことはあるか。:
――New Orc Lord.
Do you have any demands of the White Empire?
m940010.――皇帝陛下！\nここにわたくしも、決闘を申し込みますわ！:
――Your Majesty!
I, too, challenge you to a duel!
m940010.――陛下！ 緊急事態です！\nベラート伯爵領より、大規模な軍勢が出立！\n帝都へ:
――Your Majesty! An emergency!
A massive force has departed from Belart's territory!
They appear to be heading for the Imperial Capital!
m940010.――黄金戦車！ イグニッションッ！！\n皇帝をひき肉にしてやるのだぁぁぁぁぁッ！:
――Golden Chariot! Ignition!!
I'm going to grind the Emperor into mincemeat!!!
m940010.…………あと少しで呪いが完成したというのに。\n仕方あるまい、真なる神に殉ずる者:
??? : …………Just moments from completing the curse.
Very well, you who would martyr yourselves for a false god. Draw your swords.
m940010.…………参ったな。\nこれでは俺が悪役のようだ。:
…………This is awkward.
I look like the villain here.
m940010.…………？\nどうした、白の皇帝。覇気がないぞ。:
…………?
What's the matter, White Emperor? You've lost your edge.
m940010.……ああ。\nいつでも待っている。:
……I see.
I'll be waiting, any time.
m940010.……ああ。\nしかし皇帝陛下が腑抜けた様を見せた時には――:
……Yes.
But when Your Majesty showed such a lack of resolve—
m940010.……おぉ、この神殿に来客とは。\nこれもアダマス様の思し召しでしょうか。:
??? : ……Oh, a visitor to this temple.
Is this the will of Lord Adamas?
m940010.……ここへ来るに際し、\nまず最初に斬りかかられると思っていたが。: ……I expected you to lunge at me the moment I arrived here.
m940010.……ちっ、間に合いませんでした。\n自決したようです。:
…Tch, we were too late.
It seems they killed themselves.
m940010.……っ、まずいです、意識が……！: …! This is bad, he's losing consciousness!
m940010.……なんとか、容態は安定しました。\n医療でどうにかできるのは、ここまでです。:
……We've managed to stabilize his condition.
This is as far as medical treatment can go.
m940010.……まだ戦いは続く、ということだ。\n訓練ご苦労だったな、ギョウブ、カルラ。\n:
……The war is far from over.
Well done on the drills, Gyoubu, Karla.
How is the morale of the troops?
m940010.……やっぱり、こうなるんですねぇ。\nでは、立会人として見届けましょう。:
……I knew this would happen.
Very well, I shall observe as a witness.
m940010.……フッ。\n行くぞ、勝利をもってこの決闘を終わらせる。:
……Heh.
Let's go. We'll end this duel with a victory.
m940010.……何も望まん。\nこれまでどおり、オレたちは戦いに生き続けるのみだ。:
……I desire nothing.
As always, we Orcs will continue to live for battle.
m940010.……対処法は？: ……Is there a way to deal with it?
m940010.……帝都へ急ぎ戻りましょう。\nありえない事態が起こっていることは、事実です。:
……We must return to the Imperial Capital at once.
Whatever is happening, it is undeniably beyond the realm of possibility.
m940010.……敵が向こうからやってきた。\nならば、相手をしてやろう。:
……If the enemy comes to us,
then we shall face them.
m940010.……王子、肩など貸して、どういうつもりだ。: ……Prince, what do you mean by offering me your shoulder?
m940010.……見事な武技だ。\nさすがは誇り高きダークエルフの戦士たち。:
……Impressive martial skill.
Truly worthy of being the proud warriors of the dark elves.
m940010.……陛下、まさかこれを待っていたのですか？: ……Your Majesty, did you perhaps wait for this?
m940010.あ、ああ！\nこちらは……白の帝国との講和と、平和的関係を望む。:
A-Yes!
We seek a peace treaty and a peaceful relationship with the White Empire.
m940010.あ、当たり前だ。\n族長としての交渉はこれが初めてなんだぞ。:
Ah, naturally.
This is my first negotiation as Clan Leader, after all.
m940010.ああ、待っていたぞ伯爵。\nそちらが伯爵領の全軍で来るのなら――:
Ah, I've been waiting for this, Count.
If you're bringing the entire army of your territory――
m940010.ああ、我が部族は負けていない。\n今後は正々堂々、仲間として武を競い合おう。:
Indeed. My tribe has not been defeated.
From now on, let us compete in battle as equals and allies.
m940010.ああ。帝国法にのっとり、応じよう。: Ah. In accordance with Imperial Law, I accept.
m940010.ああ。決闘ならばいつでも受けてやる。: Ah. If it's a duel, I'll accept any time.
m940010.ああ見えて、色々なことを考え続けているの。\n誰かさんの影響もあるのでしょうね。: He may appear that way, but he's always thinking things through. It's likely someone's influence is at play there. He's merely reached the point where his fingers are finally touching the answer.
m940010.あっ……あー……。\nそうですねー……。\nでも、あのー、なんというかー。:
Ah… ah, I see.
I suppose so…
But, um, how should I put this…
m940010.あら、そう見える？: Oh? Do I look like it?
m940010.あら、それはあの人を甘く見すぎね。: Oh, you're far too generous in your assessment of him.
m940010.あれは……冥界人が混じっている……？\n総員！ 抜刀ーッ！！ 陛下をお護りせよ！:
There are… Netherworld entities among them…?
Everyone! Draw your blades!
Protect the Prince!
m940010.いえ、ここからではそこまでは……。: No, from here I can't tell that much……
m940010.いえ、アダマス様は、彼らにとっては異教。\n雨宿り程度をすることはあるかもしれま:
No, Adamas is a foreign faith to them.
They might stop by to shelter from the rain, but
they wouldn't visit frequently.
m940010.いえ、昔と比べて、皇帝陛下が、なんというのか……。: No, it's just that compared to before, His Majesty is, how should I put it……
m940010.いや、そろそろだと思ってな。: No, I merely thought the time was near.
m940010.いや、決闘においては例外が認められるはずだ。: No. A duel allows for exceptions.
m940010.う、うむ……。\n私は、娘の育て方を間違ったのだろうか……。:
Y-Yes…
Have I raised my daughter wrong…?
m940010.う、うむ……分かった。\nではお前たち、全力で向かってこい！:
Y-Yes… I understand.
Then you all, give it your all!
m940010.うぅー、医官の言うことはきかないのに。\nすみません王子殿下、陛下をお願いします:
Ugh, he never listens to the medics.
I'm sorry, Your Highness, please look after His Majesty.
m940010.うおおおおおッ！ ロード！！\nうおおおおおッ！！ 我らがオークロード！！:
UOOOOO!! Lord!!
UOOOOO!! Our Orc Lord!!
m940010.うおおおおおッ！ ロード！！\nうおおおおおッ！！ 誇り高きオークロード！！:
UOOOOO!! Lord!!
UOOOOO!! Our proud Orc Lord!!
m940010.うむ。ここからが本番のようだね。: Mm. It seems the real fight is just beginning.
m940010.えぇ、えぇ。\nこちらの神殿で名ばかりですが神官戦士を。\nおや、そちらの方はも:
??? : Yes, yes.
I serve as a priest-warrior here, in name only.
Oh, and you there…… could you perhaps be the Emperor?
m940010.えぇ。いま陛下の身に流れ込んでいるのは、\n冥界の冷たい魔力、そして……。: Yes. What is flowing into His Majesty right now is the cold power of the Underworld, and……
m940010.えぇ。これからの帝国に必要なのは、\n純粋な武力だけでなく、\n他者と対話で渡り: Yes. What the Empire needs going forward is not just pure military might, but the strength to engage with others through dialogue.
m940010.えっ、えぇっ！？\nそう、なるのか！？ そうなっちゃうのか！？:
E-What?!
So… that's how it is? That's what's going to happen?
m940010.えっと……もしかして、\nまた大きな戦いが……？:
Um… could it be that
there's another big war coming…?
m940010.お、お待ちを！\nこのベラート、どうなっても構いませぬ！\nですからどうか、娘の:
W-Wait!
This Belart does not care what happens to me!
Please, just spare my daughter's life—
m940010.おぉ、あれが新たな魔界の総帥、アスバール様……。\n物質界で生きることを選んだ我:
Oh, so that's the new Supreme Commander of the Demon Realm, Asbaal…
Coming all this way for us,
who chose to live in the Material World…
m940010.おぉぅ……幼い頃から\n毒殺対策を仕込み続けた弊害が……。:
Oh dear… The downside of constantly preparing for assassination
since you were a child…
m940010.おっと、族長はちゃんと\n帝国貴族としてそちらで戦ってくださいよ。:
Oh, please. As a proper imperial noble,
you should fight on their side.
m940010.おや、どうかしましたかベラドンナ伯爵。: Oh my, is something the matter, Countess Belladonna?
m940010.おや、もっと甘い汁を、と望まれないので？: Oh? Don't you wish for something sweeter?
m940010.お疲れ様です、オルドネッタさん。\nこの戦闘訓練が終わったら、\n全員で手分けし:
Good work, Ordonetta.
Once this combat drill is over,
we'll all split up and help move the supplies into the warehouse.
m940010.か、閣下！\nエンジンが赤熱しています！\n冷却装置破損！ このままでは爆発しま:
Y-Your Excellency!
The engine is glowing red-hot!
The cooling system is damaged! It's going to explode!
m940010.ぐはぁぁぁぁッ！？\nわ、我がパーフェクトベラートの装甲がぁ！？:
Gahhhhh!?
My, my Perfect Belart armor!?
m940010.この交渉次第で、皆の今後が決まる……。\n責任重大すぎて、逃げ出したいくらいだ。:
The outcome of these talks will determine everyone's future…
The responsibility is so heavy I almost want to run away.
m940010.この身に、怒りと憎悪を与え給え！！: Grant this body your wrath and hatred!
m940010.これから、貴様ら父娘には\n存分に働いてもらう。: From here on, I expect you both, father and daughter, to work to the fullest of your abilities.
m940010.これまでのクーデター、冥界軍との内通、\n帝国領土の毀損、あらゆる罪は貴様にある:
The coup, your collusion with the Netherworld Army,
the destruction of Imperial territory—every crime is yours. Correct?
m940010.これ以上など、\n望むべきではないのかもしれない……か。:
Perhaps I should not wish for
anything more beyond this……
m940010.さぁ父様、剣を。: Now, Father, give me the sword.
m940010.しかし、そこまで高く買われてしまったなら……。\n部族の実力を見せなければいけな:
However, if I am valued so highly…
I must show the true strength of my tribe.
m940010.しかし、今の帝国軍には火力！\n火力があるのです！:
But the Imperial Army has firepower!
Real firepower!
m940010.しかし、領民は幸せな生活を送っております。\n伯爵領は、帝国内でも指折りの豊かな:
And yet, the people live happy lives.
My territory is one of the most prosperous in the Empire.
That is all thanks to your management.
m940010.せめて我が末娘と、領民、\nそして兵たちの家族の未来くらいは勝ち取ろう。:
At the very least, I will secure a future for my youngest daughter,
my people,
and the families of my soldiers.
m940010.そういうわけだ。\n――では、次の戦闘訓練を始めるぞ！:
That's the situation.
――Now then, let's begin the next combat drill!
m940010.そうなんですか？\nハイドースとの戦いも終わりましたし、\n残すは戦後処理――各:
Is that so?
The war with Hydos is over, so isn't it just post-war
cleanup—negotiating peace with the various factions?
m940010.そして――正式に、帝国の民となることを要求する。\n帝国臣民として、我が民の安全:
And we formally request to become citizens of the Empire.
As subjects of the Empire, we ask you to guarantee the safety of my people.
m940010.そしてベラート、貴様は俺の下で働け。\n白の帝国貴族の名にかけて、\nその血の全:
And you, Belart, will work under me.
In the name of the White Imperial nobility,
swear to devote all your blood to the Empire.
m940010.そのために、オークの部族には\n現在の居留地を――正式に領地として与え……。\n:
For that reason, I will grant the Orc tribe
their current settlement as――an official territory…….
And to the Orc Lord, as chieftain……a title of nobility…….
m940010.そのとおり♪\nなんて言うと驚かせちゃうわね。:
You've got it right♪
I suppose that's a bit of a shock, isn't it?
m940010.その実力を、見せ続けろ。\n民を、兵を頷かせるのは、己の実績のみだ。: Keep showing that strength. It is only your own track record that will make the people and the soldiers nod in approval.
m940010.その答えのひとつが、\n父を配下につけることだと？: And one of those answers is to place my father under his command?
m940010.それが分かっているのなら、十分です。\nさぁ、伯爵としての初仕事、頑張っていらっ: If you understand that, then that is enough. Now then, do your best on your first task as a Count.
m940010.それにしても、きれいな神殿やね。\n放棄されて無人だって聞いとったけど。:
I'll say this much, though. It's a beautiful temple.
I'd heard it was abandoned and uninhabited.
m940010.それは簡単な話やねぇ。\n平和いうんは次の戦争の準備期間だけんね。:
Well, that's a simple question, isn't it.
Peace is nothing more than the preparation period for the next war.
m940010.それも全て、ベラートの働き次第だ。: That is entirely up to Belart.
m940010.そんな馬鹿な……我が黄金は……ッ！\n栄光の日々はまだ――:
No, that can't be… my golden…!
The days of glory are still――
m940010.ただ、その目印によって\n陛下の身に呼び寄せられたものが問題で……。:
The problem is what that marker
has summoned to His Majesty……
m940010.だから、兵にはここでもう一度、\n気を引き締めてもらわないとね。:
That's why we need to make sure the soldiers
stay on their toes here, too.
m940010.では、こちらからも提案しよう。\nイルヴィ族長、貴殿を帝国貴族として叙爵する。\:
Then, let us make a proposal of our own.
Clan Leader Irvit, I shall ennoblement you as a noble of the Empire.
Serve the Empire's dark elves to the fullest.
m940010.と、父様！ 顔が面白い形になってますわよ！\nしっかりしてくださいな！！:
F-Father! Your face is doing a funny shape!
Pull yourself together!!
m940010.とう、さま？ ベラート伯爵が父様……？\nって、ま、まさか！ あの子って！？:
Lord…? Count Belart is your father…?
Wait, no way! That girl is…!?
m940010.ところで――\nハイドースとの戦いも終わったというのに、\nどうしてこんな、念入:
By the way――
We've already finished the war with Hydos, so why are we
putting in so much effort into combat training?
m940010.ど、どこでそんな汚い言葉をぉっ！？: Where did you learn such vulgar language!?
m940010.どうにも気が抜けとるモンが多いなぁ。\nここらでひとつ、引き締めておかんと。:
A lot of them seem a bit too relaxed.
We need to tighten things up a bit around here.
m940010.なっ……何者だ！\nベラート伯爵の手勢か！？:
Wha… who are you?
One of Count Belart's retainers?
m940010.なるほど、黄金戦車の装甲を前に、\n通常兵器では苦戦することもあるでしょう。:
I see. Against the Golden Chariot's armor,
conventional weapons do struggle.
m940010.はぁ……はぁ……。\n全て……出し切ったぞ……。:
Haa… haa…
We… gave it everything we had…
m940010.はい。\n――この身は金剛、折れぬ刃。:
Yes.
—This body is adamantine, an unbreakable blade.
m940010.はっ、そうでした……。\n全身全霊で、帝国を支えて参ります。:
Ah, yes, that's right…….
I shall support the Empire with all my heart and soul.
m940010.はっ。\n剣に誓い、白の帝国に永遠の忠誠を捧げます。: As you command. I swear by my sword and pledge my eternal loyalty to the White Empire.
m940010.はっ！\n全軍、如何なる事態にも備えは万全です。:
Aye!
The entire army is prepared for any contingency.
m940010.ふ、ふ、ふ、ふざけるなァッ！\n誰が潔く死んでなどやるものかァ！！:
D-Don't you dare joke with me, you brat!
I'm not going to die with dignity or anything like that!!
m940010.ふざけんなですわ！\nクソ喰らえって言ってんですのよ！:
Don't be ridiculous!
I'm telling you to shut up!
m940010.ふふっ、えぇ、分かっておりますわ。\nそれこそこれまで、父がやってきたような、\: Heh, yes, I understand perfectly. You mean even the dirty methods of working in the shadows, behind the scenes, the kind my father has always employed.
m940010.ふむ……。\n無人の建物というものは、空気が淀むもの。\nしかしここは……どうや:
Hmm……
Uninhabited buildings usually have stale air.
But this place…… it seems someone is coming and going.
m940010.ふん。次は冥界で成り上がればよい。\nハイドース亡き冥界など、\n我々にかかれば:
Hmph. I'll claw my way up in the Underworld next.
With Haidos gone,
the Underworld is a walk in the park for us!
m940010.べ、ベラドンナ、我が娘よ！\nなぜここに！？ 食事には睡眠薬を――:
B-Belladonna, my daughter!
What are you doing here!? I put a sleeping draught in your dinner—
m940010.もとより、近隣の帝国都市とは\nあれこれと商売をして、関係を持っていたのだ。\n:
We have always conducted trade and maintained relations
with the neighboring imperial cities.
It is fine if we can move from outsiders to allies.
m940010.ようやく来ましたわね。\nベラート伯爵が末娘、魔剣に選ばれしじゃじゃ馬娘。:
You're finally here.
Count Belart's youngest daughter, the wild mare chosen by the demon sword.
m940010.よく分かっているじゃないか。\nしかし、今日は協力者のつもりで同行している。:
You know me well.
However, I am accompanying you today as a collaborator.
m940010.よって、伯爵領は末娘――\nベラドンナに継承することを命ずる。\nベラドンナ、貴:
Therefore, I decree that the count's territory
shall be inherited by your youngest daughter—
Belladonna. Belladonna, you are the count as of today.
m940010.わぁ、助かります！\n荷馬車でざっと数十台分ですからね！\nひとりで運び込もうと:
Oh, you're a lifesaver!
There are dozens of carts' worth of stuff!
It would have taken me three days to haul it all in by myself!
m940010.わわわ、ベネーさん。\nごめんなさい、そういう意味でうろたえてたわけでは！:
W-w-wait, Bene!
I'm sorry, I wasn't flustered because of that!
m940010.アダマス様の神官戦士なのでしょう？\n共に祈りの聖句を。\n――この身は金剛、折:
A priest-warrior of Lord Adamas, I see.
Let us recite the sacred verses together.
—This body is adamantine, an unbreakable blade. Now, let us continue.
m940010.アンジェリーネ様が、\nヴィラヘルム様が貴様を認めようと！\n私はぜぇぇぇぇった:
Angeline-sama,
Wilhelm-sama, they acknowledge you!
But I, absolutely not! I will never acknowledge you!!
m940010.ウチに気を使わなくて大丈夫だよ？: You don't have to worry about us, you know?
m940010.オークさんたちですかね？\n森からちょっと離れてますけど。:
Could it be the Orcs?
They're a bit away from the forest.
m940010.オークの流儀を甘く見ていたのは、俺の方だったようだ。\nその刃と誇りに対し、謝罪:
It seems I underestimated the Orc way of doing things.
I apologize to you and your pride.
m940010.セグナンドの兄貴に教わった武技、\nお嬢――いや、イルヴィ族長に見てほしいんです:
We want to see the martial arts
you learned from Segnand's brother, young lady—
I mean, Clan Leader Irvit.
m940010.ハイドースとの戦いは一区切りついたけれど、\n倒しました、はい平和！ とはいかな:
The war with Hydos has reached a conclusion, but
it's not like we can just declare, "We won, now it's peace!"
That's the nature of nations, ethnicities, races, and pride.
m940010.フッ……最初からそのつもりだったのだろう？: Pfft… I assumed that was your intention from the start.
m940010.フム……まぁいい。\nならば、さっそく最初の決闘をさせてもらおう。:
Hmph…… Fine.
Then let's get this first duel started.
m940010.ベラート、ベラート伯爵。\n貴様は俺に敗北した。そうだな？:
Belart, Count Belart.
You have lost to me. Correct?
m940010.マリカ、影響を受けただけではありませんよ？: Marika, it's not just that he was influenced.
m940010.万全の状態でない貴様に勝っても、\nそれはオレたちが望む誇りある勝利ではない。:
Defeating you while you are not at your best
would not be the honorable victory we seek.
m940010.今は何とも……。\nただ、確実に言えるのは――:
I can't say for certain right now……
But there is one thing I know for sure—
m940010.今後は友として、共にこの国土を守っていこう。: From now on, let us protect this land together as friends.
m940010.以前の陛下なら、わたくしも父も、\n首を刎ねてはいおしまい、だったのでは？: Had it been the Emperor of old, my father and I would simply have been beheaded, and that would have been the end of it.
m940010.仲良しこよし、という意味ではありませんよ？: I don't mean simply getting along on friendly terms, you know?
m940010.何をいう、悪徳貴族という語を辞書で引くといい。\nそこには私の名が最初に載ってい:
Don't be absurd. If you look up "villainous noble" in the dictionary,
my name will be the first one you find.
m940010.何をおっしゃいますか、伯爵殿。\n伯爵領には閣下がこれからも必要なのですぞ。:
What are you saying, My Lord?
My territory needs you more than ever.
m940010.何者かが神殿に入って来ました。\n……足音は、複数……この衣擦れは、神官の装衣？:
Someone has entered the temple.
……Multiple footsteps…… the rustling of that robe…… is it a priest's vestment?
m940010.倒した襲撃者を調べましたが、\n冥界人が紛れていました。:
I examined the attackers we defeated,
and there were Underworlders among them.
m940010.傷や病ではない、呪いが原因ですからね。\nそれも、おそらくこの世界で最も重い呪い:
It is not an injury or an illness; the cause is a curse.
And it is likely the heaviest curse in this world.
m940010.剣を交えてこそ伝わるものがあります。\n彼らとの戦いで、きっと何かを掴んだのでし:
There are things that can only be understood through the clash of blades.
In battling them, he must have grasped something.
m940010.双方、悔いのない戦いを！\n――魔界総帥アスバールが、\n誇りある戦士たちを見届:
May both sides fight without regret!
――Asbaal, Supreme Commander of the Demon Realm,
witnesses the battle of honorable warriors!
m940010.否ッ！！\n我が伯爵領には――奥の手があるッ！！:
No!!
My territory has――a trump card!!
m940010.問題だらけですよ！\nエレオノーラ様、この近くにアダマス教会は――:
It's everything!
Eleonora, is there an Adamas church nearby――
m940010.国家転覆すら狙った大罪人であろうと、\nそれを補うだけの\n価値があるなら使うと: Even if the criminal in question had plotted to overthrow the nation itself, he must have decided to employ them because their value outweighed the risk.
m940010.変わりましたよねぇ。\n誰の影響なんでしょうねぇ。:
He's changed, hasn't he.
I wonder whose influence that is.
m940010.大きな戦いを乗り越えた以上、\n気が緩んでしまうのは致し方ないことではありますが:
After a battle of that scale, it's only natural
that people would let their guard down.
m940010.大正解の育て方をしてもらいましたわ。\nだからこそ、お家の一大事において、\nこ:
You raised me perfectly.
That's exactly why I rushed here
for this great crisis of our house.
m940010.大船に乗ったつもりで\n私に背中を見せたりするがよかろう。:
Trust me and turn your back to me,
and you'll be fine.
m940010.女神アダマスなど偽りの女神に過ぎぬ。\n冥界にて封じられし我らが神よ！\n我ら、:
The Goddess Adamas is a mere false deity.
Our true god, sealed away in the Netherworld!
We are the Great Fang that shall shatter the world!
m940010.奴が決起するのであれば、今しかあるまい。: If he intends to make his move, now is the only chance he has.
m940010.奴の決着の付け方、見届けてやろう。: Let us see how he intends to settle this.
m940010.少々言葉選びが物騒ではありますが、\n紛れもない事実ですわね。:
It's a rather grim way to put it, but
it is an undeniable fact.
m940010.希望の薔薇、聖剣アングルヴァダル。\n我が娘に、背中を支えられる日が来るとは。\:
Rose of Hope, Holy Sword Anguillard.
To think the day would come when I could lean on my daughter's back.
For the pride and glory of our clan, bring us victory!
m940010.帝国は、良い国になりそうですね。: The Empire is becoming a fine country, I think.
m940010.帝国を解体することなく継続し、\nなおかつ、平和を可能な限り維持するためには、\:
If we want to keep the Empire intact and
maintain peace as much as possible,
there are plenty of issues we can't avoid, aren't there?
m940010.悲嘆の薔薇、魔剣アングルヴァダル！\n一族の危機たる今こそ、吠えて見せなさい！:
Rose of Sorrow, Demon Sword Anguillard!
In this hour of our clan's crisis, let your fury ring out!
m940010.我が部族は、常に笑えと教えられる。\n笑いながら攻め込み、退くときも堂々と笑いな:
My tribe is always taught to laugh.
We charge with a laugh, we retreat with a laugh,
and when we die, we go smiling, satisfied with every battle we have fought.
m940010.我が黄金戦車よ！\n咆哮をあげよ！\n我が黄金の道は未だ途切れてはいないッ！！:
My Golden Chariot!
Roar!
My golden path is not yet broken!!
m940010.我ら、女神アダマスの神罰代行者。\n――エレオノーラ様、この者、神官を騙る者です:
We are the agents of divine punishment, servants of the Goddess Adamas.
—Eleonora, this one is an impostor.
m940010.戦いに流儀があるように、\n国に法があることも、理解している。:
Just as battle has its code,
I understand that a nation has its laws.
m940010.手段が汚いんですのよ！\nそんなの食べたフリしてポイしましたわ！！:
How low!
I just pretended to eat it and threw it away!!
m940010.挨拶もなく失礼しました。\nあなたは、ここの神官でしょうか？:
My apologies for not greeting you first.
Are you the priest of this temple?
m940010.攻撃の手を緩めるな！\n今こそ秘密兵器を繰り出す時ッ！！:
Don't let up the offensive!
Now is the time to unleash my secret weapon!!
m940010.早馬を出せ。\n帝都の治癒士と神官に受け入れ態勢を整えさせろ。:
Send out the couriers.
Have the Imperial Capital's healers and priests prepare to receive him.
m940010.森を抜けてすぐに、戦乱で今は使われていない神殿が。: Just past the forest, there is a temple that has been abandoned since the wars.
m940010.正直、ここからが本番って感じありますねぇ。: Honestly, I feel like the real work starts now.
m940010.此度、こうして大規模な戦闘訓練を実行したのは、\n今後帝国が直面する数々の試練に:
The reason we conducted this large-scale combat training
is to prepare for the numerous trials the Empire will face going forward.
m940010.武力集団たる我々にとってはそうですが、\n国家首脳陣にとってはここからが大変なの:
For us, a military force, perhaps.
But for the heads of state, this is where the real trouble begins.
m940010.残された時間が数年しかないのなら、\nここで休んでいるわけにはいかないだろう。\:
If I only have a few years left,
I can't afford to sit here and do nothing.
The rebuilding of the Empire starts here.
m940010.気楽に行ってくださいよ。\n我々の結論は、もう出ているでしょう。\n部族全員の総:
Please, don't take it so seriously.
We've already reached our conclusion, haven't we?
Bring us the unanimous will of the entire tribe.
m940010.決して、ここですべての責任を取って散ろう、\nなどとは思わんでください。:
Please, do not think
that you must take all the blame and die here.
m940010.父様も父様ですわ！\n鎧と戦車だけを持ち出して、\n伯爵領の誇る最強の武具を置い:
Father, really…
To bring out nothing but armor and a chariot, and leave behind the finest armaments the territory has to offer.
m940010.父様直伝ですわよ。\nさぁ、お立ちになって。\n伯爵家が家宝は、まだ父様を見限っ:
Straight from the horse's mouth, Father.
Now, stand up.
The family's treasure hasn't abandoned you yet.
m940010.現在の帝国には、多数の種族が存在している。\n彼らとの対話なくして、帝国の未来は:
The Empire is home to many different races.
Without dialogue with them, the Empire has no future.
m940010.白の皇帝、貴様の首はオレが叩き落とす。\n……帝国法に則り、正々堂々と、決闘の場:
White Emperor, I will take your head.
……In accordance with Imperial law, fairly and squarely, in a duel.
m940010.皇帝、貴様との心躍る戦いを、\n死に際に誇りとして思い出せる戦いを望む。\n今日:
Emperor, I want a thrilling battle with you,
one I can look back on with pride in my final moments.
I'll leave today's outcome for another time.
m940010.皇帝、貴様は先代が認めた男だ。\n刃を交えるのなら、正々堂々であるべきだろう。:
Emperor, you are a man recognized by my predecessor.
If we are to cross blades, it should be done fairly and squarely.
m940010.皇帝の首を取れと命じてくだされば、\n我ら伯爵領に御恩ある騎士一同、\n閣下の代:
If you command us to take the Emperor's head,
we knights of Belart, who owe you our lives,
will gladly sacrifice them in your stead.
m940010.神官の施した呪いは、とても軽微なものです。\nいわば、目印をつけたようなもの。:
Curses cast by priests are usually very minor.
They are, in a sense, merely markers.
m940010.私が出ましょう。\nアダマス教徒であれば、他の教区であっても\n私を知らないもの:
I'll go out.
If they are a follower of Adamas, there should be no one
in any other parish who doesn't know me.
m940010.私たちで、良い国にするのですわよ？: We are the ones making it a fine country.
m940010.窮地にはすぐに部下を切り捨てるし、\n汚い手段も涼しい顔をして選ぶし、\nおよそ:
You discard your subordinates the moment things get tough,
you choose dirty tactics with a straight face,
and you are hardly befitting of an Imperial noble.
m940010.行きますぞ、皇帝陛下。\nこれこそが最強無敵の黄金戦車ッ！\n伯爵領が誇る最高戦:
Here I come, Emperor.
This is the strongest, invincible Golden Chariot!
The finest force my territory has to offer!!
m940010.誇り高く散った先代に、この戦いを捧げる！\nオークの戦士たちよ、オレに続けェ！！:
I dedicate this battle to my honored predecessors who fell with pride!
Warriors of the Orcs, follow me!!
m940010.講和交渉にあたり、王国より王子殿下、\n魔界よりアスバール総帥閣下に立ち会ってい:
For the peace negotiations, Prince of the Kingdom
and Supreme Commander Asbaal of the Demon Realm will attend.
m940010.負けを認めますわ。\nさぁ、ここで首を刎ねなさい。:
I admit defeat.
Now, please take my head.
m940010.貴様の様子がおかしいからだ。\n疲労、負傷……いや、呪いの類か？:
Something is wrong with you.
Exhaustion, injury…… no, is it a curse?
m940010.貴様は、ここで諦めるような男だったか？\nもしそうであれば、期待外れだが……。:
Are you the kind of man who gives up here?
If so, you disappoint me…
m940010.身体は動く。\n体調も、お前たちのおかげで随分楽になった。:
My body still functions.
And thanks to you all, I feel much better than I used to.
m940010.金と名誉、欲望で生きてきた男だ。\n欲望というのはね、人が生きていく上で\n絶対:
He's a man who lived by gold, honor, and desire.
You see, desire is an absolutely essential,
powerful force in a person's life――
m940010.長同士が和解しても、民がそうとは限らない。\nこの交渉をうまく進められなければ、:
Even if the leaders reconcile, the people may not.
If we fail to manage these negotiations well,
the Empire will continue to harbor a spark of conflict within.
m940010.閣下、下がってください！\nここは我々が――:
My Lord, please fall back!
Leave this to us――
m940010.閣下がどうしようもない腹黒で、\n底なしの野心家で、金と利権に\n目のない男だと:
The people know full well that you are
an unforgiving schemer,
an ambition without bottom,
and a man blind to nothing but gold and profit.
m940010.閣下のパーフェクトベラート装備が、耐えている！\n行ける、勝てるぞこの戦い！！:
Your Excellency's Perfect Belart equipment is holding up!
We can do this! We can win this battle!!
m940010.陛下、いったいあの男に何を期待していたのですか。\n帝国を蝕む害虫そのものではあ:
Your Majesty, what did you expect from that man?
Isn't he the very embodiment of the pestilence eating away at the Empire?
m940010.陛下、いったい何が……。: Your Majesty, what on earth is……
m940010.陛下、しかしそれでは兵が納得しないのでは――: Your Majesty, but the soldiers won't accept this—
m940010.陛下、処分を法に則るのなら、\n伯爵らの身柄は帝国法務院に――:
Your Majesty, if the punishment is to follow the law,
the count's party should be handed over to the Imperial Court of Justice—
m940010.陛下、勝負はつきました。\nベラート伯爵の沙汰は――:
Your Majesty, the battle is decided.
What shall we do with Count Belart――
m940010.陛下、失礼します。\n――っ、な、なんですかこれ。\n大変です、すごい高熱が……:
Your Majesty, forgive me.
――Oh, what is this?
It's serious, he has a very high fever……!
m940010.陛下にはアダマス様の加護があるはず。\nこの短時間で、人間の神官が編み上げた呪い:
The Prince should be under Lord Adamas's protection.
For his condition to deteriorate this much in such a short time from a curse
conjured by a human priest…
m940010.陛下！ だ、だめです！ ちゃんと寝ていてください！: Your Majesty! P-Please, no! You must get some proper rest!
m940010.陛下！ 陛下！！\nしっかりしてください！:
Your Highness! Your Highness!
Stay with us!
m940010.（……もしや、他に何か気になることが？）: (……Could it be that something else is on your mind?)
m940010.（……我が人生、果たして何を残すことができたのか）: (……What have I truly left behind in this life?)
m940010.（あの、王子？\n最初から臨戦態勢じゃないですか？）:
(Um, Prince?
Aren't you on full alert from the start?)
m940010.（どれだけ命狙われてんですかあの伯爵）: (How many times has that count tried to kill her?)
m940010.（娘たちは皆嫁ぎ、孫の顔も見ることができた。\n男児には恵まれなかったが、\n末:
(My daughters are all married, and I even got to see my grandchildren.
I was not blessed with sons, but
my youngest daughter remains at the estate, supporting me.)
m940010.（私腹を肥やし、人脈をつくり、\nおよそ伯爵家として想像しうる、\nありとあらゆ:
(I fattened my own purse, built my network,
and devoured every conceivable privilege
that a count's house could imagine!)
m940010.（私腹を肥やしまくるから自領は豊かだけど、\n交易相手には無理難題をふっかけまく:
(He's only wealthy because he skims off the top,
but he's constantly bullying his trading partners with unreasonable demands.)
